Company:
Qualcomm Atheros, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
#
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.
General Summary:
Work as part of a networking and wireless engineering team on tasks that consistently push the boundaries of performance, intelligence, and scalability. You will be working on advanced networking protocols, WiFi wireless systems, AI/ML-based traffic optimization, Linux-based data path solutions, and other features across our wireless access point and connectivity platforms. You will tackle challenges related to secure and high-performance wireless connectivity, intelligent network management, and the integration of AI/ML into real-world networking systems. If designing the intelligent, high-performance networks of the future excites you, then we share a common goal.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Requirements:
* 3-5 years of experience in software feature development with a focus on networking, wireless technologies using C and C++programming languages.
* Understanding of Linux kernel internals and hands-on experience with low-level kernel programming, including writing and modifying network device drivers.
* Solid knowledge of core networking protocols including TCP/UDP/IPv4/IPv6/ARP/DHCP, and familiarity with the Linux network stack.
* Experience with WiFi/wireless LAN protocols and Ethernet device drivers is highly desirable.
* Hands-on experience developing and integrating AI/ML models and algorithms for networking applications is a strong plus.
* Knowledge of L2/L3/L4 packet forwarding schemes such as bridging/routing/OpenVSwitch/DPDK/VPP would help you stand out from others.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation intelligent automotive experiences. As a Principal Engineer within Qualcomm AI Software, you will drive the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI software technologies powering automotive platforms across digital cockpit, in-vehicle infotainment (IVI), ADAS, autonomous driving, computer vision, voice AI, and generative AI applications.
In this position, you will serve as a technical leader and primary interface between the AI Software organization and the Automotive Business Unit. You will work closely with automotive customers, internal engineering organizations, and product teams to define requirements, drive architectural decisions, and enable successful deployment of Qualcomm AI technologies into production automotive programs.
You will combine deep technical expertise with strong program leadership skills. Your responsibilities will include representing Qualcomm in customer engagements, translating automotive requirements into AI software roadmap priorities, coordinating feature delivery across multiple engineering teams, and leading the development of robust AI solutions that meet automotive performance, reliability, safety, and quality requirements.
You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of Qualcomm's AI software stack, lead strategically important initiatives, mentor senior engineers, and drive the adoption of next-generation AI technologies across the automotive ecosystem.
Responsibilities
* Serve as the primary AI Software technical lead interfacing with the Automotive Business Unit, automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and strategic customers.
* Represent Qualcomm in customer discussions, technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and issue resolution efforts related to AI software technologies and automotive deployments.
* Lead or coordinate the design, development, integration, and delivery of AI software features required for Qualcomm Automotive platforms and products.
* Translate customer requirements and market needs into technical requirements, architecture proposals, feature roadmaps, and engineering execution plans.
* Contribute to enhancements across the Qualcomm AI Stack, including model preparation, optimization, runtime, inference, tooling, and developer workflows to support automotive use cases.
* Identify and resolve limitations within the AI software stack and collaborate across teams to deliver scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Lead cross-functional efforts involving AI Software, Automotive Engineering, Program Management, Product Management, Systems Engineering, and Platform Software teams.
* Provide technical leadership for deployment of advanced AI workloads on Automotive platform environments including:
o Computer vision
o Perception systems
o Driver monitoring
o Voice assistants
o Large language models (LLMs)
o Multimodal AI applications
o Generative AI services
* Drive architectural decisions affecting multiple products, software releases, and automotive customer programs.
* Participate in strategic planning and long-term roadmap development for AI software technologies within Qualcomm Automotive solutions.
* Ensure solutions satisfy automotive requirements related to performance, reliability, maintainability, security, and safety.
* Mentor engineers across the organization and provide technical guidance for complex architecture, optimization, debugging, and customer deployment challenges.
* Stay current with advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive systems, and industry standards to continuously improve Qualcomm's AI software offerings.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
* 15+ years of industry experience in software engineering, embedded systems, AI/ML software, or automotive software development.
* Expert-level proficiency in C/C++ software development.
* Strong software architecture and design skills, including distributed systems, embedded software, performance optimization, debugging, testing, and software lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience leading large technical initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations.
* Experience interfacing directly with customers and translating customer requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Strong understanding of embedded and systems software development environments.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and technical leadership skills.
* Ability to influence technical direction and build consensus across multiple organizations.
* Ability to make technical and business decisions in ambiguous environments with incomplete information.
* Experience in automotive software platforms, including QNX, Android Automotive, Linux, or AUTOSAR-based environments.
* Experience delivering software for automotive production programs with OEMs or Tier-1 suppliers.
* Familiarity with automotive safety and quality standards, including:
* ISO 26262
* ASPICE
* Automotive cybersecurity standards (ISO/SAE 21434)
* Functional safety development processes
* Experience with AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX, or equivalent.
* Experience with deployment and optimization of:
* CNNs
* Transformers
* Vision-language models
* Large language models (LLMs)
* Multimodal models
* Experience with edge AI inference acceleration and heterogeneous compute architectures, including CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, and AI accelerators.
* Experience with Qualcomm AI technologies, including QAIRT, QNN, SNPE, Genie, and related AI software components.
* Experience debugging complex issues spanning application software, middleware, operating systems, drivers, compilers, and hardware platforms.
* Experience with model optimization techniques, including quantization, compression, pruning, compilation, and runtime optimization.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and cross-functional programs.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies and Git-based source control management.
* Software development experience in Python.
* AI-native and agentic software development proficiency.

General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm AI Software Engineer, you will develop and implement cutting-edge machine learning techniques that enable the efficient utilization of state-of-the-art solutions across various technology verticals.
In this position, you will be responsible for assisting with the software design and development of the Qualcomm AI Stack features within Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) SDK, specifically Core software including Generative AI Inference Extensions (Genie). You will contribute to the efficient execution of advanced deep neural networks (DNNs), large language models (LLMs), and other modern AI architectures. You will also be responsible for supporting AI stack that optimizes runtime efficiency, latency and power consumption of AI applications running Machine Learning workloads on Qualcomm’s low-power AI accelerators.
You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your passion for software design and development through your analytical, design, programming, and debugging skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

* Develop software for the Qualcomm AI Stack SDKs, specifically QAIRT and Genie, to support the execution of the latest generative AI models on Snapdragon platforms.
* Design and implement core components of Qualcomm AI Stack runtime framework for inference on resource constrained AI systems, operating in low power, small memory footprint platforms
* Validate, analyze, and optimize the performance and accuracy of software through detailed testing of machine learning use cases.
* Debug complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure high system reliability

* Strong software development skills, including data structure and algorithm design, object-oriented or other software design paradigms, software debugging, and testing.
* Excellent communication skills (verbal, presentation, and writing).

* Familiarity with various generative AI model architectures such as LLMs.
* Strong understanding of hardware acceleration and deployment of generative AI inference at the connected edge.
* Experience with development in various platforms such as Linux, Android, or Windows.
* Knowledge of low-level interactions between operating systems (e.g., Linux, Android, Windows) and hardware.
* Experience with CMake-based build environments.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
The Mobile Software Architecture team is responsible for defining and delivering end‑to‑end system features across Qualcomm Mobile platforms. These features span multiple IPs, SoCs, Android layers, and OEM customizations, and are foundational to Mobile product differentiation, scalability, and commercialization.
We are seeking an experienced Director of Mobile Software Architecture focused on Snapdragon Mobile Handset products. As a senior member of the team working on Mobile Handset software architecture and software system design, you will have the opportunity to analyze requirements and architect/develop high level designs for new Use-cases and features. You will drive technical initiatives to evolve Snapdragon Mobile software, helping to drive performance and power enhancements into the SW and HW stacks and SW tools of state-of-the-art machine learning solutions on Snapdragon Mobile platform. You will work closely with development leads, software and hardware architects, project engineers, product managers, customer engineers, OEMs and external partners. This role combines technical depth, organizational leadership, OEM engagement, and execution accountability for some of the most complex system initiatives in Mobile.
Key Responsibilities
Technical & Architectural Leadership
* Own the end‑to‑end architecture of one or more critical Mobile system features, from concept through commercialization.
* Define system‑level architecture across multiple IPs and software layers, including CPU, NPU, DSP, memory, virtualization, security, kernel, and Android frameworks.
* Develop architecture for complex features and experiences built around AI for Snapdragon Mobile products; recommend architecture enhancements.
* Drive architectural clarity for cross‑SoC and cross‑product scalability.
* Represent Mobile system architecture in technical forums, architecture reviews, and executive discussions.
* Independently research and work cross-functionally to define requirements. Hands on prototype development.
* Serve as a technical expert in developing and commercializing solutions; participate in design reviews and recommend improvements to ensure alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Influence and negotiate with external partners to gain buy-in for ideas and align on project and subsystem implementation plans and milestones to ensure the needs of all stakeholders are met.
* Act as a technical expert on AI and Mobile industry trends, competitors' products, and advances in various engineering fields; share expertise within and/or across teams.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all.
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer in the Qualcomm AI Stack SDK Software team, you will provide technical leadership for bringing state-of-the-art AI models to Snapdragon platforms using Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks.
You will lead the analysis, adaptation, optimization, quantization, compilation, and execution of modern model architectures, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Large Vision Models (LVMs), Vision-Language Models (VLMs), and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). You will work closely with AI Research teams to understand model internals, identify operator- and graph-level gaps against Qualcomm AI accelerator backends, and develop scalable solutions that can be reused across model families.
The role operates at the intersection of model architecture, machine learning algorithms, graph transformations, quantization, compiler and runtime technologies, and hardware-aware optimization. You will define technical direction and improve the Qualcomm AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks through reusable model adaptations, quantization recipes, graph optimizations, compilation flows, and execution interfaces.
You will collaborate with ML Research, AI accelerator hardware and software teams, compiler and runtime teams, Product Management, Program Management, QA, and customer engineering teams to take new model architectures from initial analysis through production-quality execution on Qualcomm devices.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will lead and manage a small team of engineers while continuing to contribute as an individual contributor, drive architecture and implementation, establish engineering priorities, mentor team members, and own delivery across multiple model-enablement initiatives.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 5+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
## Responsibilities
· Lead the bring-up and enablement of new LLM, LVM, VLM, and multimodal model architectures on Snapdragon platforms.
· Partner with AI Research teams to understand model architecture, tensor flows, attention and cache behavior, model inputs and outputs, and performance-sensitive computation patterns.
· Analyze model graphs and identify operator-level, graph-level, precision, memory, and runtime gaps against Qualcomm AI accelerator backends.
· Own the architecture and design of scalable model-enablement solutions, including component boundaries, APIs, stage contracts, configuration schemas, artifact interfaces, extensibility mechanisms, and integration across model, quantization, compiler, and runtime systems.
· Define scalable approaches for model re-authoring, graph adaptation, graph lowering, decomposition, fusion, layout transformation, and backend-specific optimization.
· Architect reusable model-enablement solutions instead of model-specific workarounds, and integrate them into Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks.
· Lead the design of declarative and extensible pipeline capabilities, including reusable stages, model mappings, quantization recipes, configuration interfaces, artifact handoffs, caching, validation, and execution workflows.
· Develop and optimize model preparation, quantization, calibration, export, compilation, and on-device execution flows.
· Apply quantization techniques such as post-training quantization, quantization-aware training, mixed precision, weight and activation quantization, blockwise or groupwise quantization, calibration, and accuracy-recovery optimization.
· Evaluate accuracy, latency, throughput, memory usage, model size, and power efficiency across floating-point, prepared, quantized, compiled, and on-device execution checkpoints.
· Guide enablement of advanced Generative AI features such as KV-cache optimization, prefill and decode graphs, LoRA, Mixture-of-Experts, speculative decoding, multimodal processing, and vision encoders.
· Debug complex issues across model architecture, PyTorch and ONNX graphs, quantization, compiler, runtime, operating system, and hardware layers.
· Establish technical plans, divide work across the team, manage execution risks, and drive multiple model-enablement initiatives from initial investigation to production delivery.
· Participate in and lead architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and performance and accuracy reviews.
· Mentor engineers, develop technical expertise within the team, and establish engineering practices for maintainable and production-quality AI software.
· Communicate technical strategy, project status, dependencies, and risks to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
## Minimum Qualifications (Must Have)
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 8+ years of experience in software design, development, and delivery.
OR
· Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 6+ years of experience in software design, development, and delivery.
· 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML software development, model inference, model optimization, compiler technologies, or related systems software.
· Strong knowledge of modern AI model architectures, including transformer-based LLMs, vision models, and multimodal or vision-language models.
· Deep understanding of transformer internals, including attention, positional encoding, KV cache, prefill and decode execution, normalization, feed-forward networks, and emerging architecture patterns.
· Strong understanding of quantization and calibration concepts, including PTQ, QAT, mixed precision, weight and activation quantization, encoding generation, and accuracy-performance tradeoffs.
· Strong knowledge of computational graphs, graph transformations, operator decomposition, graph lowering, layout and shape transformations, and backend-aware optimization.
· Excellent software architecture and system-design skills, with demonstrated experience designing scalable, modular, extensible, and maintainable frameworks, APIs, and production software systems.
· Proficiency in Python and C/C++ for production-quality software development.
· Strong experience with PyTorch and ONNX model representations and tooling.
· Demonstrated proficiency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent tools for codebase exploration, design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review. Candidates must apply strong engineering judgment and validate AI-generated solutions.
· Demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar model architectures, identify software and backend gaps, and develop scalable technical solutions.
· Strong debugging and root-cause-analysis skills across model, framework, compiler, runtime, and hardware boundaries.
· Demonstrated technical leadership, including leading a small team, mentoring engineers, prioritizing work, and driving complex projects end-to-end.
· Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with research, hardware, software, product, QA, and customer-facing organizations.
## Preferred Qualifications
· Experience bringing up LLM, LVM, VLM, or multimodal models on embedded, edge, mobile, or accelerator-based platforms.
· Experience designing model-enablement pipelines or frameworks for model loading, re-authoring, quantization, export, compilation, deployment, and execution.
· Experience with AIMET or equivalent model quantization and optimization frameworks.
· Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, model repositories, tokenizers, processors, PEFT, and related ecosystem components.
· Knowledge of advanced quantization techniques such as blockwise or groupwise quantization, weight rotation, adaptive scaling, sequential MSE optimization, and quantizer-placement optimization.
· Experience with graph optimization and compiler technologies such as ONNX Runtime, ExecuTorch, TFLite/LiteRT, MLIR, or equivalent compiler and runtime frameworks.
· Experience with LoRA, MoE, speculative decoding, hybrid attention architectures, state-space or recurrent model components, and vision encoder/decoder models.
· Understanding of accelerator architecture, operator support, memory hierarchy, data movement, precision support, and hardware/software performance tradeoffs.
· Experience with Android and/or RTOS environments such as QNX.
· Experience with Linux development, CMake-based build environments, agile software development, and Git-based source control.
· Experience interacting with senior leadership and communicating technical strategy, execution status, and project risks.
· Previous experience leading and mentoring a globally distributed engineering team.
· User-level or development experience with commercial AI software stacks and model-enablement frameworks, including model conversion, optimization, compilation, deployment, and runtime tools.
· Exposure to Snapdragon SoCs and AI accelerators such as NPUs or HTPs.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > CPU Engineering
General Summary:
## About the Role
We are building a high-performance, production-grade RISC-V Instruction Set Simulator (ISS) that serves as the golden reference model for a family of next-generation 64-bit RISC-V processors. The ISS is a key component of our verification flow: it drives co-simulation against RTL, powers random test generation, and gives software teams a fast, accurate platform to develop and debug pre-silicon firmware.
The work is at the intersection of computer architecture, systems software, and verification engineering — writing the kind of C++ that has to be both correct to the bit and fast enough to run long-running benchmarks and boot Linux.
##
## What You'll Work On
* Implementing the ISA: Translate RISC-V specification chapters into working C++ code. We cover a wide range of extensions: integer, floating-point, vector, bit manipulation, security features, interrupt handling, and more.
* Simulation correctness: Help maintain the fetch/decode/execute engine, memory protection, virtual memory, and privilege-level logic that make the simulator a trustworthy reference.
* Co-simulation: Work on the harness that runs the ISS alongside RTL and flags any differences, one instruction at a time.
* Testing: Write targeted unit tests that exercise individual features and compare against expected results derived from the RISC-V spec.
* Developer tooling: Contribute to and maintain a large collection of simulator extensions and utilities that help the user community be more productive.
##
## What We're Looking For
* Solid C++ skills and comfort reading unfamiliar codebases.
* Comfortable with basic processor architecture, including pipelines, memory, privilege levels, and interrupts.
* Strong attention to detail; this work is spec-driven and correctness matters.
* Willingness to read a specification document and turn it into tested code.
* Some exposure to low-level or systems programming, such as embedded systems, operating systems, compilers, or hardware description.
##
## Nice to Have
* Experience with RISC-V, x86, or ARM architecture.
* Familiarity with simulators or emulators such as QEMU, Spike, gem5, or similar tools.
* Experience with GDB, ELF binaries, or bare-metal bring-up.
* Background in hardware verification or RTL co-simulation.
* Knowledge of Linux internals.
* Python 3+ experience.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
#
Are you excited about developing advanced GNSS and positioning technologies that power billions of devices worldwide?
Qualcomm's Location Technology Team is looking for highly motivated software engineers to design and deliver next-generation positioning solutions for future wireless platforms. Qualcomm's advanced GNSS and location technologies are deeply integrated into our chipsets and enable accurate, reliable, and power-efficient positioning across mobile, wearable, automotive, IoT, and other connected platforms.
As a GNSS Positioning Engine Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, testing, and optimization of Qualcomm's core GNSS Positioning Engine. The Positioning Engine is responsible for transforming GNSS measurements and sensor inputs into high-accuracy Position, Velocity, and Time (PVT) solutions used across Qualcomm platforms.
You will work closely with GNSS systems, measurement engine, sensor, hardware, software, and test teams to develop and commercialize state-of-the-art positioning technologies that deliver industry-leading location performance. The role also leverages modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, including large language models (LLMs) and coding assistants such as Claude, Codex, and similar technologies, to improve software development productivity, code quality, debugging efficiency, data analysis, and system performance optimization.
Role Responsibilities
In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and optimization of real-time embedded GNSS positioning software.
Key responsibilities include:
Design, develop, review, and maintain production-quality GNSS Positioning Engine software in C/C++. Implement and optimize GNSS positioning algorithms, including Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filtering (KF/EKF), and Position/Velocity/Time (PVT) estimation. Develop algorithms and software for processing GNSS measurements, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier-phase, satellite ephemeris, clock, atmospheric, and other measurement corrections. Develop and optimize GNSS/INS and multi-sensor fusion algorithms using inertial sensors and other positioning technologies.
Contribute to advanced positioning technologies including multi-frequency GNSS, hybrid positioning, sensor-assisted navigation, AI/ML-enhanced positioning solutions and emerging XR use cases.
Work closely with GNSS systems engineers to translate positioning algorithms and system concepts into efficient, robust, production-quality embedded software. Collaborate with the GNSS Measurement Engine team to consume and process GNSS observables and optimize end-to-end positioning performance. Develop robust algorithms for satellite selection, measurement weighting, outlier detection and rejection, fault detection, integrity monitoring, and positioning error mitigation. Analyze and improve positioning accuracy, availability, robustness, convergence time, and reliability under challenging GNSS environments including urban canyons, indoor, and high-dynamic scenarios. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level positioning and performance issues using GNSS measurements, logs, simulations, and field-test data. Develop software within a real-time, multi-threaded embedded architecture, including inter-process communication and multiple software and firmware interfaces. Contribute to software architecture, interface design, design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, and development methodology. Optimize positioning software for CPU/MIPS utilization, memory footprint, latency, and power efficiency.
Work closely with systems, software, firmware, hardware, validation, and product teams to commercialize positioning technologies across Qualcomm platforms.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications
* Strong understanding of GNSS positioning fundamentals, navigation algorithms, and PVT estimation.
* Experience with Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filters (KF/EKF), estimation theory, statistical signal processing, or optimization techniques.
* Experience implementing GNSS positioning and navigation algorithms in embedded or real-time software systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, or similar technologies) for coding, debugging, performance analysis, test automation, and engineering productivity is highly desirable.
* Understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier phase, satellite clock and orbit errors, ionosphere, troposphere, multipath, and receiver measurement errors.
* Experience with GNSS/INS integration and multi-sensor fusion.
* Familiarity with GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, and multi-frequency GNSS.
* Experience with robust estimation, measurement weighting, outlier rejection, integrity monitoring, and fault detection techniques.
* Knowledge of RTK, PPP, carrier-phase positioning, or other precise positioning technologies.
* Understanding of navigation filter tuning, covariance modeling, uncertainty estimation, and performance characterization.
* Experience analyzing GNSS logs, measurement data, simulation outputs, and large-scale field-test datasets.
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), multi-threaded software architectures, and ARM-based development/debugging.
* Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as TRACE32.
* Experience using MATLAB, Python, or Perl for algorithm development, simulation, automation, and data analysis.
* Experience optimizing embedded software for computational complexity, memory usage, latency, and power consumption.
* Ability to understand the end-to-end GNSS receiver and positioning architecture, from measurement generation through the final position solution.
* Familiarity with Android location architecture, mobile positioning systems, or connected-device location technologies.
* Experience applying AI/ML techniques to positioning, navigation, or sensor fusion problems is a plus.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across software, systems, and test teams.
Why Join Qualcomm Location Technology?
Qualcomm's GNSS and positioning technologies power devices used by billions of consumers worldwide. Our innovations enable navigation, fitness tracking, emergency services, automotive applications, wearables, and emerging location-based experiences across a wide range of connected platforms.
As part of the Location Technology Team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge positioning solutions, collaborate with leading experts in GNSS and navigation technologies, and help shape the future of location experiences for next-generation wireless products.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise and hands-on development experience in Linux kernel and system software. The role involves solving complex problems across areas such as CPU scheduling, CPU topology, power and performance management, workload optimization, virtualization, memory management, and hardware/software interaction.
You will work closely with hardware architects, kernel developers, firmware teams, power performance teams, virtualization teams, and other software organizations to develop and optimize system software for current and future platforms. You will be expected to independently investigate difficult problems, contribute to architecture and design decisions, develop production-quality kernel software, and apply deep technical expertise throughout platform development and commercialization.
Key Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and optimize Linux kernel technologies, with emphasis on CPU scheduling, CPU topology, CPUFreq/DVFS, and power and performance management.
* Analyze and resolve complex system-level issues spanning workloads, Linux kernel, firmware, CPU architecture, cache/memory hierarchy, and hardware.
* Develop and optimize scheduler policies, workload placement, frequency management, topology-aware scheduling, and workload-aware performance optimizations.
* Evaluate new processor and SoC capabilities and contribute to the corresponding Linux kernel architecture, design, and implementation.
* Characterize workloads and analyze scheduling behavior, CPU utilization, scalability, latency, cache behavior, power, and performance to identify and implement system-level improvements.
* Develop, debug, and validate kernel technologies across QEMU, FPGA emulation, and production silicon, using tools such as ftrace, tracepoints, perf, trace-cmd, crash analysis, and JTAG.
* Collaborate with hardware, firmware, performance, and other system software teams through architecture discussions, design/code reviews, platform enablement, and commercialization.
* Contribute to the upstream Linux kernel community and open-source projects, provide technical guidance to other engineers, and document key architecture, design, and validation decisions.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

* Independently investigate and solve highly complex problems involving Linux scheduling, CPU topology, power/performance management, virtualization, and platform software.

* Share technical knowledge and mentor other engineers while maintaining primary responsibility as a hands-on technical contributor.
* Collaborate with internal engineering organizations, customers, partners, and the open-source community to resolve complex system software and commercialization issues.

* Makes significant technical contributions to architecture and design decisions within areas of expertise.
* Independently identifies, analyzes, and resolves problems that span multiple software and hardware components.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > CPU Engineering
General Summary:
About the Role
You will contribute to a Python-based random test generation (RTG) framework and its companion assembler library that together form the core of a RISC-V CPU design-verification toolchain. The RTG drives a JIT-style, simulator- coupled generator that produces ELF binaries exercising the RVA23.1 ISA — including privileged modes, virtual memory, interrupts, vector, and cryptography extensions. The assembler library provides the bit-accurate instruction encoding
layer that the RTG and other tools consume.
What You'll Do
* Implement new generation objects for RISC-V extensions; common micro-architectural scenarios; and complex data/control-flow composable idioms.
* Add instruction forms and encodings to the python companion assembler and verifying bit-level correctness against the RISC-V ISA spec.
* Write and tune generation themes which are knob-driven test profiles that compose objects to improve RTL coverage.
* Work within the privileged-software stack: exception/interrupt handlers, page-table builders, PMP configuration, and IMSIC programming sequences.
* Work with ISS and RTL verification engineers to triage failures, add targeted regression scenarios, and adjust constraint logic (register allocators, address-space managers, data fillers).
What We're Looking For
* 2–5 years of experience in CPU design verification, ISS development, or hardware-software co-design.
* Solid Python 3 skills; comfort with generator-based coroutines and object- oriented design patterns.
* Working knowledge of the RISC-V ISA: instruction encoding formats (R/I/S/B/ U/J, compressed, vector), CSR semantics, privilege levels (M/S/U), and the memory model. Alternatively, similar knowledge for x86 or ARM.
* Familiarity with virtual memory (Sv39/Sv48), PMP, and trap/interrupt handling.
* Exposure to random test generation flows or ISS/RTL co-simulation is a plus.
Nice to Have
* Compiler development experience.
* Understanding of hypervisor and/or AIA/IMSIC interrupt architecture.
* Familiarity with constraint-propagation libraries.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

General Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Program Management Tools team. This role sits at the intersection of agentic AI workflow development and full-stack web applications. You will design and build AI agents that automate the program and product management lifecycle — idea intake, requirements management, planning, execution status reporting, and cross-team coordination — running in parallel with the agentic SW engineering AI SDLC workflow. You will also build full-stack web applications with AI capabilities for our program managers, product managers, engineering leaders, and executives.

* Work with a team of talented SW engineers delivering innovative solutions.
* Design and implement agentic systems, advanced orchestration logic, and the reasoning workflows behind them.
* Develop and maintain high-performance, scalable, and reliable SW and web applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and solve complex software problems.

* Design, build, and deliver AI agents that automate workflows

* Strong programming skills in C#, .NET, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Angular, Node.js, HTML, and CSS
* Exposure to building or integrating AI-driven or GenAI-assisted features within enterprise applications.

* Ability to take high-level direction and independently drive end-to-end implementation
* Prior experience in a matrixed, global organization with distributed teams.

General Summary:
Qualcomm is looking for a highly motivated Embedded Systems Software Engineer to join our Data / Networking software team. In this role, you will design, develop, optimize, and maintain high‑performance Ethernet networking and data‑path drivers for Qualcomm's Wireless Broadband connectivity, Automotive Infotainment and Telematics platforms based on Qualcomm's Snapdragon and Dragonwing SOCs.
You will work at the intersection of Linux kernel / QNX networking stacks, Ethernet device drivers, SoC hardware (Ethernet MACs, PHYs, switches), and networking performance. The role involves close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, platform software, validation, and customer-facing engineering teams to enable robust, scalable, and production‑quality Ethernet solutions for diverse product segments. You will be responsible for developing, integrating and commercializing device driver SW for various integrated and discrete Ethernet solutions, enabling leading edge networking features while meeting stringent reliability, availability and performance requirements for demanding applications and use cases. You will collaborate with cross functional teams across multiple locations through the development lifecycle and work in a highly dynamic and engaging environment.
Job Responsibilities
* Design, develop, integrate, and maintain embedded software across the full development lifecycle, including driver development, platform bring‑up, feature enablement, debugging, and validation for embedded systems.
* Develop and debug low‑level software components, including device drivers, firmware, and RTOS/Linux kernel modules, working closely with hardware to ensure correct and efficient operation.
* Perform on‑target and off‑target development and debugging, using standard embedded debug tools and techniques to diagnose and resolve functional, performance, and stability issues.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including hardware design, systems, integration, test, application engineering, and customer support, to deliver integrated system solutions.
* Contribute to technical design reviews and project planning, providing strong engineering input on architecture, trade‑offs, schedules, and risk areas.

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, and act as a strong individual contributor within the team while driving engineering excellence.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

* Strong proficiency in C programming, with experience developing or debugging low‑level system software.

* Memory management, interrupts, DMA, synchronization primitives.

* Hands‑on experience with networking concepts, such as:

* Direct experience with Ethernet MAC or switch driver development
* Familiarity with automotive or embedded SoCs
* Exposure to QNX networking or other RTOS networking stacks.
* Experience analyzing and optimizing CPU utilization, latency, and throughput in networking workloads.
* Prior contributions to upstream Linux kernel or experience maintaining downstream kernel forks.
* Knowledge of networking virtualization or offload technologies .
* Strong interest in system performance, root‑cause analysis, and end‑to‑end data‑path optimization.
* Ability to collaborate across software, hardware, and systems teams and communicate technical topics clearly.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Innovation Center, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
# This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.
Qualcomm’s Systems Software Power team is seeking a Power Systems Software Engineer who is passionate about solving complex power challenges and developing innovative solutions to optimize power efficiency for next‑generation Snapdragon platforms.
In this role, the engineer will have a unique opportunity to learn, contribute, and directly influence the full lifecycle of mobile SoC power consumption, spanning system‑level hardware and software power architecture and design, modeling and measurement, post‑silicon debug and analysis, feature optimization, and eventual commercialization of best‑in‑class power solutions across Qualcomm products.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
Responsibilities:
* Drive end‑to‑end power optimization by working across architecture, hardware, firmware, kernel, Android, and system software teams to develop deep expertise in power architectures, control loops, and advanced low‑power techniques across use‑cases and targets
* Define, prototype, and evaluate new power features early, leveraging pre‑silicon platforms (emulation, models, trace‑based studies) and carrying them through post‑silicon bring‑up, validation, and productization
* Own post‑silicon power KPI execution (Day-of-Use (Battery Life), game and multimedia use-cases), including root‑cause debug, power walks, correlation, and systematic optimization across HW/SW boundaries
* Perform software trade‑off analysis using rapid prototyping, experiments, and trace‑driven studies to assess alternative scheduler, DVFS, low-power mode, and system‑level design choices under real workloads.
* Identify and deliver power optimization opportunities by tuning or developing firmware, Linux kernel, and system algorithms (e.g., scheduler, LPMs, bus/DDR scaling, SoC power state transitions) aligned with evolving hardware architectures.
* Contribute to and scale power debug, analysis, and automation infrastructure, including power telemetry, tooling, and AI‑assisted workflows, to improve execution velocity, coverage, and quality across platforms and geographies.
Skills/Experience
* Strong foundation in computer architecture and system design, including memory management and hierarchies, CPU/GPU architectures, and operating system fundamentals such as processes, threads, and scheduling.
* Proven embedded software development expertise, with the ability to design and implement moderately complex systems software; hands‑on experience with firmware and Linux kernel development is required.
* Solid understanding of electrical engineering and digital logic fundamentals; familiarity with low‑power design principles and power‑saving techniques is a strong plus.
* Effective communicator and collaborative team player, capable of working independently while contributing productively in cross‑functional, multi‑disciplinary environments.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
# What You'll Do
## Feature-Level Test Strategy & Planning
* Partner with delegate engineers from feature inception to define testability requirements, acceptance criteria, and subsystem test plans covering ORT QNN-EP, ExecuTorch HTP backend, and LiteRT delegate
* Own SSIT test strategy per feature: scope, entry/exit criteria, coverage targets, and risk-based prioritization — aligned with the development team before implementation begins
* Embed in sprint planning, design reviews, and code reviews to ensure features are architected for testability from day one
## Test Content Development & Execution
* Develop and maintain automated test content targeting the subsystem boundary: op and feature coverage, numerical accuracy, model-level functional correctness, and backend interface contracts
* Validate on-device behavior on Snapdragon SoCs using HIL infrastructure, covering functional correctness, latency, and memory under real hardware conditions
* Build Python/PyTest-based test suites integrated into the Delegates CI pipeline; ensure SSIT gates are enforced on every code change
* Develop and leverage AI-assisted tooling and agentic workflows (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test content generation, coverage analysis, and failure triage
## Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis
* Triage failures and isolate root causes across the delegate stack — ML framework → QNN runtime → HTP hardware — and drive resolution with development owners
* Flag integration risks early during feature development; distinguish subsystem-level issues from upstream framework bugs and downstream backend or system integration issues
## QA & SIT Handoff
* Define and own handoff criteria from SSIT to QA and SIT: documented test results, known issues, coverage gaps, and risk summaries that give downstream teams a clear picture of feature readiness
* Serve as the primary technical liaison between the Delegates development team and QA/SIT — translating feature context into actionable test guidance for downstream teams
* Maintain traceability between SSIT artifacts and QA/SIT test plans via JIRA; feed defects found in QA/SIT that trace to subsystem gaps back into SSIT coverage
# Minimum Qualifications
* Bachelor's + 8 years or Master's + 6 years in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related field
* Strong Python; proven hands-on experience building automated test frameworks (PyTest or equivalent)
* C/C++ reading proficiency sufficient to debug delegate and runtime issues at the source level
* Demonstrated experience in subsystem or integration testing within a hardware/software product development cycle
* Experience with CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and integrating test automation into build pipelines
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with ability to isolate failures across multi-layer software stacks

* Experience validating ML inference frameworks — ONNX Runtime, ExecuTorch, TFLite / LiteRT, or equivalent
* Hands-on experience with Qualcomm QNN, HTP/DSP, or Snapdragon SoC-based on-device validation
* Familiarity with model accuracy validation: quantization correctness, op-level numerical comparison, and tolerance analysis
* Python and C++ proficiency for development and debug of tests
* Cross-platform test experience: Linux, Android, and Windows (ARM64 or x86)
* Experience with JIRA defect tracking and Agile/scrum development practices

* Sets the SSIT quality strategy and test architecture for the full Delegates portfolio at Staff level — operates independently with minimal direction
* Co-owns feature quality from day one alongside development engineers; defines what 'done' means from a subsystem validation standpoint before handoff to QA
* Primary technical bridge between the Delegates development team and downstream QA/SIT — owns the clarity and completeness of that interface
* Mentors junior and senior SSIT engineers; establishes team norms for test coverage, triage discipline, and handoff documentation standards
* Collaborates with CI/Build/Release engineers to ensure SSIT automation is embedded in the delivery pipeline and readiness signals are visible to Program Management

qualcomm-3095960.text:
##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Multimedia Systems
General Summary:
About Qualcomm Robotics
The Qualcomm Advanced Robotics Team is building the AI-first stack for the next generation of general-purpose robots — from AMRs and cobots to emerging humanoids — pairing heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/DSP/NPU) with a full Robotics SDK, an integrated simulation platform, and AI operations infrastructure. With our high-performance robotics SoCs, workloads that previously required the cloud now run on-device, at the edge, at scale.
About This Team
We build AI infrastructure for modern robotics. The simulator is a central tool in it: a modern platform developed in-house, built on high-performance computing and open data formats such as OpenUSD, URDF, and glTF, intended to be best-in-class, and tuned for Qualcomm robotics SoCs and the robots they run on. The robots span the field — tabletop manipulation with robotic arms, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long-horizon tasks that carry a robot through multi-stage scenes requiring reasoning over many steps. This is a ground-up software effort: runtime architecture, performance, clean APIs, and developer tooling.
The simulator is a first-class target on both developer workstations and cloud compute — interactive authoring and vectorized GPU environments locally, orchestrated headless jobs at scale in the cloud. We use it to train policies, generate synthetic data for robot foundation models, gate software releases in CI, run hardware-in-the-loop against real silicon, and close the sim-to-real gap on deployed robots. We deliver jointly with Qualcomm’s AI operations workstreams, and a meaningful slice of the engineering sits where simulation plugs into the training, dataset, and deployment infrastructure they own.
The Opportunity
You will own significant pieces of a simulation platform on the critical path of Qualcomm’s robotics products — the runtime and its abstractions, the physics and rendering integrations, the training and data-generation paths, the HIL and CI plumbing, or the developer experience that makes all of it usable by robotics engineers who are not simulation specialists — across robot arms, legged platforms, and mobile robots.
This is first and foremost a simulation role — roughly 80% of the work is the simulator itself as a critical platform component. The remaining ~20% is AI infrastructure enablement: integrating simulation into the training, dataset, and deployment pipelines owned by the AI operations team, working with them rather than replacing them.
The role is open from mid-level through senior/staff, roughly 2 to 10+ years. We calibrate level from your depth during the interview loop, so apply if you are anywhere in that range.
What You’ll Do
* Design and build core simulator subsystems — scene representation and authoring, physics backends, sensor models, rendering — across the scenarios our robots work in: tabletop manipulation, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long-horizon, multi-stage tasks.
* Profile and optimize simulation and training workloads — physics solvers, rendering, data pipelines — so interactive workstation sessions and training throughput at scale stay high.
* Integrate and extend best-in-class open engines — GPU physics, USD/Hydra rendering, offline path tracing — behind clean, swappable interfaces.
* Build high-throughput paths for policy training and synthetic data generation: vectorized environments, GPU-resident state, procedural scene variation, domain randomization, and ground-truth labeling — consistent from an interactive workstation session to scheduled headless runs in the cloud.
* Make simulation a release gate: scenario suites, deterministic replay, benchmarks, and metrics that catch regressions before they reach hardware.
* Enable the continuous learning workflows that simulation feeds into, in partnership with the AI operations team: make simulation a first-class, config-driven stage in collect–merge–train–eval pipelines with reproducible run manifests and artifacts, so the same experiment runs locally and as containerized GPU jobs (Argo Workflows on Kubernetes) without the sim engineer owning the surrounding infrastructure.
* Stand up hardware-in-the-loop configurations: production robotics software running on Qualcomm silicon in communication with the simulator on the host workstation or cloud, and quantify where simulation and reality diverge — system identification, contact and actuator modeling, sensor noise, measured transfer results.
* Partner with AI operations, perception, controls, and silicon teams, and own the design docs, reviews, tests, and APIs others depend on.
Who We Look For
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, with production code you can talk through in depth.
* A working grasp of simulation as applied to robotics: rigid-body dynamics, kinematics, coordinate frames, numerical integration, or sensor models. — or the aptitude to build one quickly; engineers from games, graphics, and ML infrastructure backgrounds ramp well here.
* You pick up unfamiliar stacks quickly and independently, and you use modern AI tooling effectively in your development loop.
* You would rather converge two half-parallel code paths than add a third, and you are comfortable where some layers are settled design-of-record and others are still being validated.
* You are motivated by physical AI: work that ends in a robot that functions, not only a benchmark number.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Engineering or related work experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Depth in two or three of these matters more than familiarity with all of them. If you're excited about this role but don't match every qualification, we encourage you to apply.
* Robotics simulators or real-time 3D engines: MuJoCo/MJX, Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab, Newton, PhysX, Gazebo, Drake, Unreal Engine, or Unity. Candidates from games, VFX, or AV simulation are welcome — these skills transfer directly.
* GPU programming and performance engineering: CUDA, Warp, Vulkan, compute shaders, or accelerator-aware data layout.
* Machine learning for robotics: reinforcement learning at scale, imitation learning, robot foundation models and VLAs, PyTorch.
* 3D graphics and scene pipelines: OpenUSD composition, PBR materials, real-time and offline rendering, sensor simulation.
* Robotics and distributed systems: ROS 2/DDS, URDF/MJCF, pub/sub and schema-driven wire formats, containers, cluster orchestration, and CI/CD for compute-heavy workloads.
* Working fluency in the AI infrastructure around simulation — enough to integrate with it and partner effectively with the AI operations team (who own it), not to run it yourself: Kubernetes-native workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows or similar), containerized GPU jobs and shared-storage datalakes (NFS/PVC volumes), config-driven experiment frameworks, checkpoint/resume semantics, and experiment tracking (TensorBoard, Weights & Biases).
* Effective leverage of modern AI tools as a core engineering skill: frontier AI models, AI coding and agentic workflows, AI-assisted learning for ramping on new domains quickly, and building knowledge bases — personal or team — to accelerate on-boarding and future work.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
* Designs, develops, integrates, and validates the in-house simulation platform and its tooling, targeting Qualcomm robotics SoCs and robots across form factors and scenarios — tabletop manipulation, legged locomotion, navigation and vision, and long-horizon multi-stage tasks.
* Specifies environments, tasks, and evaluation criteria for training and assessing robot policies; partners directly with robotics researchers and engineers to iterate on tooling, workflow, and model performance until results hold up on real hardware.
* Builds digital twins of robots, sensors, and work cells, and hardware-in-the-loop configurations where the robotics stack runs on Qualcomm silicon against a simulator on the host, so algorithms are developed and validated before hardware time is committed.
* Builds synthetic data pipelines for robot foundation models and task models, and simulation-based regression suites that gate software releases.
* Works with the in-house sensor teams to model sensor behavior from real characterization and calibration data, delivering high-fidelity sensor simulation modules.
* Works closely with the robotics AI infrastructure team to complete the data flywheel: a continuous learning pipeline spanning data generation, training, evaluation, deployment, and back to data generation.
* Performs code reviews and regression tests; triages and fixes issues; at senior levels, leads design and testing efforts.
* Collaborates with hardware, systems, test, and AI operations teams so simulation integrates with the rest of the program; at senior levels, engages external partners and industry collaborations to advance simulation technology and shape shared roadmaps.
* Writes and reviews technical documentation, design rationale, and knowledge-sharing material for complex software projects.
* At senior levels, articulates technical findings and engineering due diligence — measured capabilities, trade-offs, and honest limits — to leadership, informing roadmap and strategy decisions.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in.
The MMODE team develops protocol software that enables intelligent system selection and mobility across terrestrial and satellite wireless networks. MMODE software determines how devices discover, select, acquire, and transition between available connectivity options while balancing user experience, network performance, power efficiency, and operator requirements. Engineers work on technologies including 5G NR, LTE, NTN, Multi-SIM, emergency services, and next-generation connectivity solutions, collaborating closely with systems, modem firmware, and test teams to deliver innovative wireless features.
As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource-constrained C/C++ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS-level components.
Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly AI-native. You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI-assisted development workflows — using code-generation agents, LLM-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
* Design, implement, and optimize real-time embedded modem software across protocol layers, drivers, and platform services, meeting strict latency, memory, and power constraints.
* Apply rigorous data-structure and algorithm design to build efficient, scalable firmware components.
* Own end-to-end feature delivery: requirements, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, on-target bring-up, and maintenance.
* Pioneer AI-native development practices within the team — integrate AI coding agents into daily workflows, establish agent rules and prompt patterns, and measurably reduce development and debug cycle time.
* Build and maintain AI-assisted tooling for code review, static analysis, test synthesis, and automated crash/log triage over the modem codebase.
* Debug and root-cause complex, multi-layer issues on target hardware, increasingly leveraging AI-assisted analysis of logs, traces, and RAM dumps.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and integration teams to deliver production-quality modem firmware.
* Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering standards — including standards for the responsible and effective use of AI in the SDLC.
* Mentor peers on both embedded fundamentals and AI-native engineering techniques.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
We are looking for experienced software engineers to help build and advance the software ecosystem for large-scale LLM inference on Qualcomm platforms.
In this role, you will work at the intersection of open-source LLM serving systems, distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI accelerator software. You will contribute to open-source projects such as llm-d and related LLM inference engines, while developing the integrations and capabilities required to run these systems efficiently and reliably on Qualcomm AI accelerators.
Depending on your background and interests, you may focus more heavily on either distributed LLM serving and orchestration or inference runtime and accelerator integration, while collaborating across both areas.
This is an opportunity to work directly with leading open-source communities and help shape the next generation of scalable, production-grade LLM inference infrastructure.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
## Responsibilities
* Contribute features, improvements, bug fixes, and architectural enhancements to open-source LLM inference projects, including llm-d and other open-source LLM inference and serving projects.
* Develop and improve support for Qualcomm AI accelerators in open-source LLM serving frameworks.
* Work with upstream maintainers and open-source communities to design, review, and upstream Qualcomm-related functionality.
* Develop and enhance inference engine integrations for Qualcomm platforms, including device abstraction, accelerator runtime integration, memory management, distributed execution, compilation, and performance optimization.
* Develop and improve llm-d integration and deployment capabilities for Qualcomm platforms, including reference architectures, deployment blueprints, configuration, and operational tooling.
* Design and implement distributed LLM inference capabilities such as:
* Prefill/decode disaggregation
* KV-cache management and transfer
* Distributed communication and high-performance data movement
* Request routing and load balancing
* Tensor, pipeline, expert, and other forms of model parallelism
* Multi-node and scale-out inference
* Autoscaling and resource management
* Failure detection, recovery, and service resiliency
* Integrate LLM inference software with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure, including scheduling, autoscaling, networking, observability, and lifecycle management.
* Profile, benchmark, and optimize end-to-end inference performance, including time to first token (TTFT), inter-token latency (ITL), throughput, memory utilization, and scalability.
* Diagnose complex issues spanning model-serving frameworks, distributed runtimes, operating systems, networking, accelerator runtimes, and hardware.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, firmware, compiler, runtime, Kubernetes, and product teams to define requirements and deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Develop technical documentation, examples, reference deployments, and best practices to help customers and developers deploy LLM workloads on Qualcomm platforms.
* Participate in architecture discussions and help influence the technical direction of Qualcomm's open-source LLM inference software strategy.
## Qualifications
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong software engineering and debugging skills.
* Experience developing production-quality software in one or more of Python, C++, Go, or Rust.
* Strong understanding of at least one of the following areas:
* Machine learning or LLM inference systems
* Distributed systems
* AI accelerator or GPU software
* Cloud-native/Kubernetes infrastructure
* ML compiler or runtime systems
* Experience working with complex software systems and debugging problems across multiple layers of the stack.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
## Preferred Qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:
* LLM inference engines, model-serving frameworks, or distributed inference systems.
* Architecture and implementation of high-performance LLM inference runtimes, including model execution, scheduling, memory management, attention, and KV-cache management.
* Distributed LLM inference architectures, including prefill/decode disaggregation and KV-cache transfer.
* llm-d, KServe, Kubernetes Gateway API, Kubernetes operators, or cloud-native AI infrastructure.
* PyTorch internals, torch.compile, Dynamo, Inductor, Triton, MLIR, or other compiler/runtime technologies.
* Hardware accelerator software stacks, GPU programming, or custom AI accelerator integration.
* RDMA, RoCE, GPU Direct-style communication, PCIe, high-speed networking, or distributed communication libraries.
* Model parallelism, including tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, expert parallelism, and data parallelism.
* Performance profiling and optimization of distributed AI workloads.
* Kubernetes scheduling, autoscaling, networking, observability, and production operations.
* Open-source development, including contributing patches, participating in design discussions, reviewing code, and collaborating with upstream maintainers.
* Experience working across hardware/software boundaries with hardware, firmware, compiler, runtime, and systems teams.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Software Engineering
General Summary:
The Wireless Research and Development (WRD) Technology division is seeking a motivated engineer to join the Modem Performance and Architecture team within the Modem Power and Performance (MPP) organization. This is a high‑visibility individual contributor role with direct impact to Qualcomm’s next‑generation modem products and help shape the long-term modem roadmap.
In this role, you will work in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment across software, hardware, and systems engineering teams to analyze real modem workloads, evaluate architectural trade-offs and drive measurable improvements in performance, power, and efficiency. The team plays a critical role in ensuring that modem designs meet aggressive performance goals and scalability targets across Qualcomm’s expanding product portfolio including the next generation of intelligent edge devices, such as AI-Native 6G smartphones, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and IOT devices.
Over time, engineers in this position will have the opportunity to gain end-to-end exposure to the product lifecycle – from early‑stage architectural exploration and pre-silicon analysis through post‑silicon validation and commercialization – making this an ideal opportunity for individuals who thrive at the intersection of deep technical work and system‑level impact. If you are an engineer driven by technically challenging problems, energized by work at the intersection of software and architecture, and excited to see your work directly influence products at scale, we encourage you to apply.
Responsibilities
As a Modem Performance and Architecture engineer, you will own or contribute to one or more of the following areas:
* * Play key significant role for several foundational architectural initiatives that are expected to influence multiple future generations of Qualcomm modem and Compute products
* Contribute to innovations and inventions covering advanced memory architecture and optimization, performance optimization, cache level compression/decompression, and related technologies.
* Address critical challenges across power/performance/area (PPA), memory efficiency, reliability, security, software productivity, and platform scalability while helping shape future modem and DSP roadmaps
* Help drive strategic initiatives focused on platform robustness, security, and debuggability
* Define and evaluate SoC-level performance requirements, including latency, throughput, and bandwidth constraints, and assess architectural trade-offs against these requirements.
* Participate in pre-silicon performance evaluations, architectural exploration, and performance sign-off activities.
* Analyze real-world modem workloads to identify performance and efficiency bottlenecks, and propose or implement solutions across software optimization, task design, SW/HW partitioning, cache utilization, and memory behavior.
* Apply data-driven analysis techniques, including traditional ML methods where appropriate, to large performance datasets spanning multiple modem and chipset generations.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain tools for silicon profiling, performance validation, and debug to support the above activities.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
Preferred Qualifications:
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason about complex systems.
* Strong fundamentals in computer architecture, including processors, memory systems, embedded real-time systems, operating systems, and low-level programming.
* Ability to deliver quantifiable improvements in code performance through techniques including, but not limited to, architectural redesign, compiler optimizations, hardware acceleration, and multithreading
* Experience working with embedded software development using C/C++ (or ASM) with RTOS schedulers and kernel modules.
* Strong programming capabilities with C (or C++) and Python.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* In addition to the above, an ideal candidate would have one or more of the following:
* * Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering (or foreign academic equivalent).
* Up to five (5) years of cumulative work experience in a relevant field.
* Experience contributing to performance analysis, and/or optimization on embedded systems.
* Experience using Python for tooling, data analysis, ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch), or automation.
* Debug experience using JTAG or equivalent hardware/software debug tools.
* Exposure to compiler technology, low-level performance tuning, or system-on-chip (SoC) architecture.
* Working knowledge of wireless protocols and technologies.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Familiarity with traditional machine learning and/or generative AI.

General Summary:
Qualcomm is looking for a highly motivated AI/ML Software Engineer to develop next-generation AI capabilities for gateway and edge products. This role will focus on applying Generative AI, LLMs/SLMs, agentic AI, and traditional machine learning to create intelligent networking experiences and services. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI/ML experience and an interest in deploying AI on resource-constrained edge platforms. The engineer will work across on-device, cloud, and hybrid AI architectures to enable intelligent diagnostics, network optimization, security, automation, and user experiences.

* Design and develop AI/GenAI features and use cases for gateway and edge products, translating real-world networking problems into production-ready AI solutions.

* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design.

* Experience developing or integrating AI/ML models, LLMs, or AI inference frameworks.
* Good understanding of Linux systems development and debugging.
* Understanding of AI performance characteristics such as latency, throughput, memory utilization, model accuracy, and compute requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to debug issues across software, AI models, and system layers.
