* Experience with LLMs/SLMs, model inference, quantization, fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, and context management.
* Experience with agentic AI, function/tool calling, MCP, or similar agent frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI runtimes and hardware acceleration across CPU, GPU, and NPU.
* Experience with model ecosystems and tooling such as PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face, GGUF, or equivalent frameworks.
* Understanding of networking, broadband gateways, Wi-Fi, telemetry, diagnostics, or network management.
* Experience profiling and optimizing AI workloads for latency, memory, compute, and power constraints.
* Experience taking AI capabilities from prototype through productization and production deployment.

Qualcomm’s Systems Software Power team is seeking a Power Systems Software Engineer who is passionate about solving complex power challenges and developing innovative solutions to optimize power efficiency for next‑generation Snapdragon platforms.
In this role, the engineer will have a unique opportunity to learn, contribute, and directly influence the full lifecycle of mobile SoC power consumption, spanning system‑level hardware and software power architecture and design, modeling and measurement, post‑silicon debug and analysis, feature optimization, and eventual commercialization of best‑in‑class power solutions across Qualcomm products.

* Strong foundation in computer architecture and system design, including memory management and hierarchies, CPU/GPU architectures, and operating system fundamentals such as processes, threads, and scheduling.
* Proven embedded software development expertise, with the ability to design and implement moderately complex systems software; hands‑on experience with firmware and Linux kernel development is required.
* Solid understanding of electrical engineering and digital logic fundamentals; familiarity with low‑power design principles and power‑saving techniques is a strong plus.
* Effective communicator and collaborative team player, capable of working independently while contributing productively in cross‑functional, multi‑disciplinary environments.

General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
General Summary:
Qualcomm’s Automotive Platform Systems team designs and delivers reference platforms used for post-silicon validation, software development, and high-volume production test of Qualcomm Automotive chipsets. These highly integrated reference designs incorporate our high‑performance SoCs and a wide range of digital and analog peripherals required to showcase our performance in use cases for both Snapdragon Cockpit In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) and Snapdragon Ride Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) applications.
The APS Software team is composed of embedded software engineers with deep expertise in low‑level device drivers, firmware, and hardware/software interfaces. The team develops bare‑metal software and validation firmware used to bring up, test, and validate Qualcomm reference platforms. Work is performed in a fast‑paced, hands‑on environment that directly supports hardware design validation, factory test enablement, and early platform bring‑up across multiple global sites.
This role requires strong technical depth in low‑level embedded software development and close collaboration with hardware, silicon, and systems teams. The ideal candidate is a self‑motivated problem solver who can work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team.
Technical Skills and Experience:
* Strong expertise in device driver and bare‑metal software development, including register‑level programming, GPIO configuration, and hardware bring‑up.
* Working knowledge of hardware interfaces and protocols including SPI, USB, I2C/I3C, I2S, PCIe, UART, UFS, DP, MIPI CSI/DSI, CAN, and Ethernet.
* Proficiency with debug and bring‑up tools such as Lauterbach Trace32 and JTAG‑based debuggers.
* Experience with common Automotive peripherals such as ASIL-D Microcontrollers, CAN Transceivers, Camera/Display SerDes, PCIe Switches, Ethernet Swtiches and PHYs.
* Hands‑on experience using lab equipment including oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and bench power supplies.
* Solid understanding of ARM and/or RISC‑V processor architectures.
* Experience using software revision control systems such as Perforce.
* Ability to interpret datasheets, hardware design documents, schematics, and CCA drawings.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams.
Roles and Responsibilities:
* Develop and maintain bare‑metal firmware and low‑level device drivers to enable bring‑up and validation of Qualcomm Automotive reference platforms.
* Perform early hardware bring‑up and debug of new boards and chipsets, identifying issues across hardware, firmware, and system boundaries.
* Implement and extend test firmware used for platform validation, manufacturing test, and factory enablement.
* Collaborate closely with hardware design, silicon, systems, and validation teams to define requirements and resolve hardware/software integration issues.
* Analyze failures using schematics, register traces, logic analyzer data, and lab instrumentation, and drive issues to resolution.
* Support multiple platforms and hardware variants, adapting software to different configurations and use cases.
* Contribute to code reviews, documentation, and best practices for low‑level embedded software development.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on embedded software, debugging techniques, and platform bring‑up.
* Participate in cross‑site and cross‑functional reviews, providing clear technical communication and status updates.
Minimum Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
* 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications:
* 8+ years of experience in embedded systems development, device drivers, or firmware development.
* 8+ years of hands‑on experience with engineering lab tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and JTAG debuggers.
* 8+ years of programming experience using languages such as C, C++, Python, Assembly, or similar.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > DSP Architecture and Design
General Summary:
General Summary
Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS.
As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open-source community.
What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will:
* Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low-level system software components.
* Own and drive resolution of complex system-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness.
* Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment.
* Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions.
* Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards.
* Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration.
* Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement.
* Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization.
You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high-performance, low-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will:
* Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture.
* Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability.
* Own features end-to-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support.
* Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality.
Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will:
* Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components.
* Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers.
* Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long-term maintainability.
* Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project.
* Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices.
* Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem.
* Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration.
* Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm-maintained components.
* Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions.
* Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership.
How You Work (Tools, Automation & Modern Engineering)
Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means:
* Applying modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, when they meaningfully improve productivity or code quality.
* Leveraging automation, scripting, CI systems, debuggers, profilers, static analysis tools, and simulation environments to improve engineering effectiveness.
* Exercising strong engineering judgment regarding when automation is appropriate and when deeper hands-on investigation is required.
* Continuously identifying opportunities to improve engineering workflows, developer productivity, and software quality.
You are not expected to be an AI expert, but you are expected to be tool-fluent, curious, adaptable, and pragmatic.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
• 2+ years of experience with high-performance microprocessor design.
Preferred Qualifications
* Strong hands-on experience with RTOS concepts and low-level system software.
* Professional development experience in C/C++ (assembly language experience is a plus).
* Deep understanding of RTOS fundamentals such as scheduling, interrupts, synchronization, memory management, and multicore systems.
* Experience debugging complex embedded software using logs, traces, crash dumps, and hardware debuggers.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to collaborative software projects using Git and modern code-review workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and technical organizations.
* Experience with Zephyr, QuRT, FreeRTOS, Linux kernel, or other commercial/open-source operating systems.
* Prior experience serving as a maintainer, subsystem owner, or technical lead within an open-source project.
* Significant upstream contribution history within Zephyr or similar open-source communities.
* Experience reviewing and integrating code contributions from multiple developers.
* Familiarity with board support packages (BSPs), device drivers, architecture enablement, or kernel development.

Job Overview:
Qualcomm's Data Center team develops cutting-edge rack-scale AI inference solutions for next-generation liquid-cooled data centers. As part of our rapid expansion, we are seeking an experienced and highly skilled engineer to drive system-level bring-up, debug, validation, and failure analysis of accelerator cards, servers, and rack-scale platforms. This role will focus on identifying, triaging, and resolving hardware and software issues while developing robust test processes and operational infrastructure to support the delivery of industry-leading AI products.
Key Responsibilities
* Drive end-to-end debug activities, including issue triage, root cause analysis, and communication with stakeholders.
* Investigate hardware, firmware, and software failures encountered during card, server, rack, and test fixture bring-up.
* Gather, analyze, and correlate failure data to identify trends, isolate root causes, and drive corrective actions.
* Develop, integrate, and document hardware and software bring-up, validation, and debug processes.
* Design and enhance test automation infrastructure to improve debug efficiency, validation coverage, and test stability.
* Execute validation plans and debug methodologies for accelerator cards, server platforms, Ethernet, PCIe, and high-speed I/O interfaces.
* Create debug tools, test scripts, and diagnostic procedures to accelerate issue reproduction and resolution.
* Prioritize and track issue resolution and communicate progress through regular updates on root causes, corrective actions, and overall status.

OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Systems Engineering or related work experience.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

* Proven experience debugging and validating enterprise-class hardware, firmware, and software systems.
* Strong understanding of server architectures, AI accelerators or GPU cards, PCIe, networking, and system integration.
* Hands-on experience with failure analysis methodologies and root cause investigation.
* Proficiency using hardware debug equipment, including oscilloscopes, JTAG tools, and other diagnostic instrumentation.
* Familiarity with Linux-based automation environments and scripting.
* Hands-on experience working in laboratory environments and performing system bring-up activities.
* Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and hardware debug skills in a Linux environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines.

* Experience with server manufacturing test, failure analysis, or system qualification.
* Experience developing debug and test automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical skills with experience processing and interpreting large sets of hardware validation or manufacturing test data.
* Experience debugging PCIe, Ethernet, memory, power, or signal integrity issues using protocol or logic analyzers.
* Experience supporting rack-scale AI, HPC, or data center platforms.
* Experience supporting DevOps and IT infrastructure activities in engineering lab and test environments.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm's software CPU (aka application processor) architecture group develops long-term software roadmaps (for a horizon of three to five years). It is responsible for defining architecture specifications, developing prototypes, and engaging with the software and hardware worldwide partners to influence products development. It is also acting as an operational execution team enabling commercialization of the most up-to-date worldwide CPUs integrated in Snapdragon’s chipsets for markets such as: Handsets, IOT devices, Automotive, Compute/Laptops, XR, etc.
The team is currently looking for an experienced CPU software engineer, who can contribute to design and development of low-level firmware for CPU bootstrapping, power controller etc. The candidate will specifically be engaged in the following domains:
Design and development of firmware of boot, debug, idle and active CPU power management CPU software/hardware design trade-offs Coordinating debugging of critical SW issues that are artifacts of any high-performance CPU microarchitecture (prefetching, speculation, memory ordering etc...) Definition of short and long-term SW architecture roadmap in accordance with Arm’s architecture ISA evolution Represent the CPU SW teams in engagements with Arm/ RISC-V architects and third-party software partners (e.g., Google, MSFT, RISE etc.)
Since the contributions of the CPU software organization affect a large span of products, the function provides an uncommon exposure to multiple technology domains related to system-on-chip development. To fully benefit from the role’s opportunities, the candidate must demonstrate a motivation to influence the products roadmap, as he or she, will directly contribute to Qualcomm’s most innovative products.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
• 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications:
* 15+ Years of Experience in the embedded domain to design, develop and support software solutions on multi-core CPUs with Strong C/C++ programming skills.
* Very deep expertise in the subject of computer architecture especially in more than one of the following areas – Memory consistency, Coherency, Memory Management, Virtualization, Security/ Sandboxing, Super Scalar Architectures
* Good understanding of system wide bottlenecks that may influence CPU performance/ throughput.
* Very good exposure to ARM or RISC-V architectures.
* Embedded Platforms experience including low-level drivers and firmware, kernel, and user-space components.
* Design and development of software for heterogeneous compute platforms consisting of ARM or RISC-V CPUs and specialized hardware accelerators in an embedded SoC systems.
* Usage of J-TAG or ICE debuggers Experience in real-time SW development for embedded products.
* Hands on experience of driver development on any RTOS .
* Detailed understanding of some of SoC hardware blocks - Clocks, PLLs, GPIO, Interrupt Controllers (GIC, PLIC), Peripherals (SPI/I2C/PCIE/CAN/Ethernet/USB/UFS).
* Motivated self-starter with excellent verbal and written communication skills, demonstrated ability to work with engineers/partners/customers across different geographies.
* Demonstrated experience working with senior management in a corporate environment.
* Demonstrated experience in business process streamlining and transformation that includes disciplined approach to digitized services enabling.
* Hands-on technical lead who is not hesitant to dig into the details where needed to get first-hand knowledge of the issues and play an active and personal role in steering team success.

##

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation, creating a smarter, connected future for all.
As an Engineer / Senior Engineer in the Qualcomm AI Stack SDK Software team, you will contribute to bringing modern AI models to Snapdragon platforms using Qualcomm’s AI software stack and model-enablement frameworks.
You will work with senior engineers to analyze, adapt, optimize, quantize, compile, and validate AI models, including Large Language Models, vision models, Vision-Language Models, and multimodal models. You will collaborate with AI Research and AI accelerator hardware and software teams to understand model architectures, identify operator- and graph-level backend gaps, and integrate reusable solutions into Qualcomm’s model-enablement frameworks and SDK.
This role combines AI/ML software development with graph processing, model optimization, systems software, and on-device execution. You will gain hands-on experience with model loading, graph adaptation, quantization, calibration, compilation, runtime integration, performance analysis, and debugging across software and hardware layers.
The role emphasizes strong programming fundamentals, hands-on implementation, problem-solving, and collaboration. Engineers will work under the guidance of technical leads, while Senior Engineers will take greater ownership of feature design, implementation, debugging, and delivery.
## Responsibilities
· Contribute to the bring-up and enablement of new language, vision, vision-language, and multimodal models on Snapdragon platforms.
· Study model implementations and computational graphs to understand model inputs, outputs, operators, tensor shapes, data flow, and execution behavior.
· Work with AI Research and backend teams to identify unsupported operators, graph patterns, precision constraints, and performance limitations.
· Implement model re-authoring, operator decomposition, graph transformations, layout changes, and backend-specific adaptations.
· Develop reusable model support that can be integrated into Qualcomm’s model-enablement frameworks rather than creating isolated model-specific solutions.
· Implement and maintain pipeline stages, model mappings, quantization recipes, configuration models, artifact handling, and validation utilities.
· Convert, optimize, and export models from PyTorch and ONNX for compilation and execution on Qualcomm AI accelerators.
· Apply and validate quantization and calibration flows, including weight and activation quantization, mixed precision, PTQ, and accuracy-recovery techniques.
· Measure and improve model accuracy, latency, throughput, memory consumption, model size, and power efficiency.
· Work with Generative AI inference concepts such as transformer attention, KV cache, prefill and decode execution, LoRA, MoE, and speculative decoding.
· Support vision and multimodal processing flows, including image processors, vision encoders, language backbones, and cross-component artifact integration.
· Debug issues across model code, computational graphs, quantization, compiler, runtime, operating system, and hardware layers.
· Develop unit, integration, accuracy, performance, and on-device validation tests.
· Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-documented Python and C/C++ code.
· Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and testing cycles.
· Collaborate with globally distributed engineering, research, hardware, QA, product, and customer-facing teams.
· Senior Engineers will independently own larger features, contribute to design decisions, mentor junior engineers, and drive assigned model-enablement work through completion.
## Minimum Qualifications (Must Have)
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
· Engineer: Project or internship experience for entry-level candidates, or 1+ years of experience in software development.
OR
· Senior Engineer: 2+ years of experience in software design, development, and delivery.
· Good programming skills in Python and/or C/C++.
· Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, debugging, testing, and source control.
· Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts, including neural networks, deep learning, model inference, and common model execution workflows.
· Practical experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent tools for code exploration, implementation, testing, and debugging, with the ability to review and validate generated code.
· Ability to read and understand unfamiliar software and model implementations.
· Strong analytical and debugging skills, with the ability to perform structured root-cause analysis.
· Ability to collaborate effectively within a team and communicate technical concepts clearly.
· Ability and willingness to learn model architectures, graph processing, quantization, compiler, runtime, and hardware-aware optimization concepts.
## Preferred Qualifications
· Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
· Coursework, internship, project, or professional experience involving AI/ML inference, model optimization, or embedded AI software.
· Familiarity with PyTorch, ONNX, Hugging Face Transformers, or related AI/ML frameworks.
· Familiarity with graph-based model representations and tooling such as ONNX, TorchScript, MLIR, ONNX Runtime, ExecuTorch, or TFLite/LiteRT.
· Basic understanding of model quantization and calibration, including PTQ, QAT, weight and activation quantization, and mixed precision.
· Experience or coursework involving transformer-based models, LLMs, vision models, or multimodal models.
· Understanding of common transformer components such as attention, normalization, feed-forward layers, positional encoding, and KV cache.
· Experience with Linux-based software development.
· Experience developing or optimizing embedded, mobile, edge, or system-level software.
· Exposure to Android or an RTOS environment such as QNX.
· Familiarity with CMake-based builds, Git-based source control, code reviews, and agile software development practices.
· Experience writing unit tests, integration tests, and debugging software across multiple abstraction layers.
· Exposure to model performance analysis, profiling, memory optimization, or hardware accelerator programming.
· User-level or development exposure to commercial AI software stacks and model-enablement frameworks, including model conversion, optimization, compilation, deployment, and runtime tools.
Exposure to Snapdragon SoCs, NPUs, HTPs, or other AI accelerator architectures.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

This includes analyzing project requirements, preparing schedules, coordinating team tasks, and ensuring that projects meet quality standards and are completed on time.

* Work with Software Product (SP) PE internally and manage external customer deliverables/expectations/escalations

* Prepare, schedule, coordinate, and monitor the assigned engineering projects.

General Summary:
Our Mission
We are transforming cloud and AI infrastructure through next-generation ARM-based datacenter computing platforms. Qualcomm's server-class SoCs combine industry-leading performance, power efficiency, open software ecosystems, and hyperscaler-scale capabilities to power the next generation of cloud and AI workloads.

You will collaborate with world-class architects and engineers to enable standards-based, production-ready platforms supporting modern datacenter deployments.
Job Summary:
Qualcomm is seeking an experienced ARM Server Platform I/O & Interconnect Software Architect to lead the architecture and software enablement of PCIe, CXL, and Interrupt Controller subsystems for next-generation ARM server SoCs.
The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in ARM server architecture, PCIe and CXL technologies, interrupt controller architecture (ARM GIC), virtualization, firmware, and Linux kernel internals. The candidate should be comfortable operating across the entire software stack including platform firmware, operating systems, virtualization, RAS, manageability, and performance optimization.
As a Software Architect, you will provide technical leadership across SoC architecture, platform firmware, HLOS, virtualization, validation, and customer enablement teams. You will be responsible for defining scalable software architectures that enable high performance, reliability, serviceability, virtualization, and ecosystem compliance for hyperscale datacenter deployments.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

* Own the software architecture for PCIe, CXL, and Interrupt Controller subsystems across ARM server platforms, including architecture definition, requirements, enablement strategy, and ecosystem alignment.
* Drive architecture and software enablement across firmware and HLOS components including:
* * UEFI/EDK2
* Arm Trusted Firmware (TF-A)
* OpenBMC
* Linux Kernel
* KVM/Hypervisors
* Datacenter operating systems and distributions

* * ARM SBSA
* SBBR
* SystemReady
* PCI-SIG specifications
* CXL Consortium specifications
* ACPI
* UEFI

* Prepare and present architecture proposals, design specifications, technical roadmaps, and executive-level reviews for internal and external stakeholders. ​

* 10+ years of experience in systems software, platform firmware, operating systems, or SoC architecture.
* Strong understanding of ARM64 server architecture and modern server platform design.
* Hands-on experience with:
* * PCIe architecture and software enablement
* CXL architecture and ecosystem
* ARM GIC interrupt architecture
* IOMMU/SMMU technologies
* Strong familiarity with:
* * Linux kernel internals and device drivers
* KVM and virtualization technologies
* Platform firmware (UEFI/EDK2, TF-A, BMC firmware)
* ACPI and platform discoverability mechanisms
* Experience driving cross-functional architecture initiatives across hardware and software organizations.
* 15+ years of experience in software development & design for commercially deployed compute platforms.
* Deep expertise in multiple areas including:
* * PCIe Gen5/Gen6/Gen7
* CXL 2.x/3.x
* ARM GICv3/v4
* SMMUv3
* ARM virtualization architecture
* Server RAS technologies

* Understanding of confidential computing technologies and trusted firmware architectures.
* Prior experience delivering platform software for hyperscalers, cloud service providers, OEMs, or datacenter infrastructure products.
* Demonstrated leadership in open-source software communities and upstream Linux development. ​
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

## Job Area:

General Summary:
## About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Autonomous Driving AI team and help build the next generation of end-to-end driving intelligence. In this role, you will develop advanced deep learning systems that directly map multimodal sensor inputs into safe and reliable driving behavior.
You will work at the intersection of machine learning, autonomous driving, behavioral planning, large-scale training infrastructure, simulation, and safety-critical evaluation. The ideal candidate is passionate about building production-grade AI systems and advancing the state of the art in autonomous vehicle technology.
## Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and optimize state-of-the-art end-to-end autonomous driving models.
* Build scalable machine learning pipelines for data processing, training, validation, and deployment.
* Develop multimodal deep learning architectures that leverage vision, map, route, and vehicle context information.
* Design and implement behavioral planning and trajectory generation models.
* Develop goal-conditioned driving systems and controllable AI planning frameworks.
* Create robust evaluation methodologies and metrics for measuring model quality, safety, and driving performance.
* Develop simulation-based validation and closed-loop evaluation frameworks.
* Investigate failure cases and long-tail scenarios to improve model robustness and generalization.
* Design data augmentation, synthetic data generation, curriculum learning, and self-training approaches.
* Collaborate closely with perception, planning, simulation, systems, and software engineering teams.
* Drive innovation through new algorithms, technical leadership, publications, and patent generation.
* Contribute to production deployment and optimization of machine learning models on automotive platforms.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

* 5+ years of industry or research experience in machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, robotics, or autonomous driving.
* Strong programming skills in: PythonPyTorchC++ (preferred)

* Experience training and evaluating large-scale deep learning models.
* Experience building end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion through deployment.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals including code quality, version control, testing, and reproducible experimentation.
* Experience in autonomous driving, ADAS, robotics, or embodied AI.
* Experience with end-to-end planners and AI planning systems.
* Experience with trajectory prediction, motion planning, or behavior modeling.
* Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or self-supervised learning.
* Experience building simulation and closed-loop evaluation frameworks.
* Familiarity with ONNX, TensorRT, distributed training, and model optimization techniques.
* Publications at top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or CoRL.
* Experience filing patents or developing novel machine learning technologies.
## What You'll Work On
* End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems
* Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models
* AI-Based Driving Planners
* Goal-Conditioned Driving Policies
* Large-Scale Deep Learning Training Infrastructure
* Trajectory Prediction and Vehicle Behavior Modeling
* Closed-Loop Evaluation and Simulation
* Safety-Critical Validation Pipelines
* Data-Centric AI and Long-Tail Learning
* Autonomous Vehicle Foundation Models
## Why Join Us
You will have the opportunity to solve some of the most challenging problems in artificial intelligence and autonomous driving while working with a world-class team of researchers and engineers. qualcomm-3097500.text:
##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in.
The Modem Systems Software team builds the low-level firmware and protocol software that powers cellular connectivity across billions of devices worldwide — spanning smartphones, automotive, IoT, fixed wireless access, and next-generation 5G/6G platforms. We are re-imagining how modem software is designed, built, verified, and maintained in an AI-native paradigm, where large language models, agentic tooling, and machine-assisted engineering are first-class parts of the development lifecycle.
As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource-constrained C/C++ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS-level components.
Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly AI-native. You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI-assisted development workflows — using code-generation agents, LLM-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
* Design, implement, and optimize real-time embedded modem software across protocol layers, drivers, and platform services, meeting strict latency, memory, and power constraints.
* Apply rigorous data-structure and algorithm design to build efficient, scalable firmware components.
* Own end-to-end feature delivery: requirements, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, on-target bring-up, and maintenance.
* Pioneer AI-native development practices within the team — integrate AI coding agents into daily workflows, establish agent rules and prompt patterns, and measurably reduce development and debug cycle time.
* Build and maintain AI-assisted tooling for code review, static analysis, test synthesis, and automated crash/log triage over the modem codebase.
* Debug and root-cause complex, multi-layer issues on target hardware, increasingly leveraging AI-assisted analysis of logs, traces, and RAM dumps.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and integration teams to deliver production-quality modem firmware.
* Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering standards — including standards for the responsible and effective use of AI in the SDLC.
* Mentor peers on both embedded fundamentals and AI-native engineering techniques.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications
At least two years' experience in the below areas:
Core Embedded & Systems Engineering
* Strong command of data structures and algorithms with the ability to reason about time/space complexity in memory- and cycle-constrained environments.
* Deep understanding of operating systems concepts: scheduling, concurrency, interrupts, memory management, IPC, real-time constraints, and RTOS internals (e.g., QuRT, ThreadX, FreeRTOS, or similar).
* Proven programming proficiency in modern C/C++ (C++17 and beyond), including performance optimization, cache-aware design, and lock-free/thread-safe patterns.
* Experience with embedded software on DSP and Arm architectures, including familiarity with SIMD/vectorization, DMA, and low-power design.
* Experience with debugging on target hardware — JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, crash-dump / RAM-dump analysis, and log parsing.
* Familiarity with device drivers, HAL layers, boot flows, and hardware/software co-design.
AI-Native Engineering
* AI-first mindset: you treat AI tooling as a core engineering multiplier, not an afterthought. You default to designing workflows where an AI agent does the first draft of code, tests, and analysis, and the engineer curates, validates, and hardens.
* Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cline, Claude/GPT-based agents) to generate, refactor, and review embedded C/C++ at scale.
* Ability to build and maintain AI-augmented developer workflows: prompt libraries, agent rules, retrieval-augmented context over large firmware codebases, and MCP-style tool integrations.

Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G, ushering in an era of rapid advancements in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is only the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to turn 5G’s potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age, and this is where you come in.
For more than a decade, Qualcomm has pioneered connected car technologies and continues to play a central role in the evolution of automotive infotainment, autonomous driving, and related technologies, including 4G/5G, ADAS, and deep learning. Qualcomm works closely with standards bodies, industry consortiums, automakers, and operators to advance Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) and Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) standards and architectures. As a key member of the Towards 5G initiative, Qualcomm is also helping drive the advancement of Cellular V2X (CV2X) capabilities on the path to 5G. By integrating connectivity into the latest infotainment, cluster, and telematics systems, Qualcomm is making travel safer, more efficient, and more enjoyable.
We are looking for talented and motivated software engineers who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on the technologies and automotive products that will shape the future. Join our growing, multi-site development team and contribute to innovations that redefine mobility.
About the role You'll be the senior technical authority for the embedded Linux platform software powering automotive telematics systems — owning architecture and execution across boot, security, memory, and virtualization, from silicon bring-up through production launch with global automakers.
What you'll do
* Own the platform software stack end to end across multiple telematics chipset generations, from initial bring-up through commercialization and long-term sustaining support
* Architect boot and recovery solutions, including fail-safe and dual-image recovery paths, over-the-air update flows, and NAND/eMMC storage support
* Contribute to platform security work — mandatory access control, verified boot, disk integrity verification, and full-disk encryption — and drive automotive cybersecurity threat analysis and risk assessment for key features
* Set and defend boot-time and memory footprint targets, leading cross-team optimization efforts against firm customer commitments
* Help architect fusion configurations integrating third-party application processors with cellular modems over PCIe, USB, and Ethernet
* Plan kernel and Yocto upgrade roadmaps and release trains, balancing launch commitments against ongoing feature demand
* Ensure automotive software process compliance for all new platform feature development
* Help translate customer requirements into platform features and build configurations
* Mentor engineers across boot, security, memory, and virtualization domains, and set technical direction ahead of market demand
In this role, you will help develop next-generation Automotive Telematics products. Working with Tier 1 suppliers, OEMs, and industry partners, you will apply your system software expertise, coding skills, and problem-solving abilities to deliver innovative solutions. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across multiple locations to design, develop, and drive system solutions through commercialization.

PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

* Deep expertise in embedded Linux systems software, including kernel development, bootloaders, Yocto-based build systems, and board bring-up
* Proven track record of optimizing boot time and memory footprint on resource-constrained embedded platforms
* Strong knowledge of embedded security and automotive cybersecurity standards
* Experience delivering software to automotive OEMs within formal development, quality, and process frameworks
* Ability to provide technical leadership across teams without direct authority and successfully drive cross-organizational commitments
* Solid knowledge of system software and platform-level debugging, including pre-silicon and SoC bring-up
* Experience with industry-standard software development tools, including debuggers, code revision systems (Git, Perforce), IDEs, and build tools
* Experience with Linux kernel device driver development
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS)
* Excellent programming skills in C, C++, Assembly, and scripting languages
* Experience working with AI-based software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
* Experience working in large organizations
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent planning, time management, decision-making, presentation, and organizational skills
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
About the Role
Qualcomm AI Hub is the platform for on-device AI — enabling developers to easily integrate, optimize, and deploy ML models on Qualcomm devices. Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench lets developers compile trained PyTorch or ONNX models into deployable artifacts targeting a variety of runtimes — LiteRT, ONNXRuntime, or Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK (QAIRT) — and profile and validate them on real Qualcomm devices hosted in the cloud.
Join the Qualcomm AI Hub Compiler team and own the infrastructure that powers these model compilations. You will work across the full compilation pipeline — from model ingestion and graph optimization to backend dispatch across CPU, GPU, and NPU — ensuring models compile correctly, execute efficiently, and scale across a growing catalog of on-device use cases spanning vision, audio, speech, and multi-modal models.
What You'll Do
Compiler Pipeline & Infrastructure
* Design, develop, and maintain the end-to-end compilation pipeline powering Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench, from PyTorch and ONNX model ingestion through graph optimization to deployable artifacts targeting LiteRT, ONNXRuntime, or QAIRT on Snapdragon SoCs
* Build and maintain ONNX-based compilation paths using ONNX IR: graph transformation passes, op validation, and opset compatibility handling
* Build and maintain PyTorch compilation paths consuming torch.export output, including dynamic shapes, custom ops, and ATen IR decomposition
* Contribute to ONNXRuntime QNN execution provider: graph optimizations, graph partitioning, and op validation and lowerings
* Collaborate with QAIRT and QNN teams to ensure correct and efficient model execution across CPU, GPU, and NPU backends
* Build tooling to analyze, profile, and debug compilation failures, accuracy regressions, and performance degradations; develop clear, actionable developer-facing diagnostics
Model Catalog, Automation & Collaboration
* Own compilation and validation of models published on Qualcomm AI Hub, ensuring correct conversion and verified performance across supported runtime targets
* Build and maintain automated compilation pipelines and CI/CD evaluation harnesses to scale model onboarding as the Qualcomm AI Hub model catalog grows
* Partner with internal Business Units to onboard models through Qualcomm AI Hub compilation workflows, translating deployment constraints (target SoC, latency budgets, memory limits) into concrete compilation strategies
* Author technical documentation, tutorials, and example notebooks for the Qualcomm AI Hub developer community
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
Preferred Qualifications:

* Proficient in Python and C++
* Solid understanding of ML compiler concepts (graph IRs, operator fusion, shape inference, lowering passes, backend partitioning) and hands-on experience with one or more compiler stacks such as MLIR, ONNX, or TVM
* Experience with PyTorch model export (torch.export, torch.compile, FX, ATen IR) and on-device deployment frameworks such as LiteRT, ExecuTorch, or ONNXRuntime
* Familiarity with SoC-level constraints (memory bandwidth, compute precision, NPU/DSP execution) and hardware-specific runtimes such as QAIRT/QNN is a plus
* Experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for model compilation and validation at scale
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; proficiency with git and software engineering best practices
Level of Responsibility

* Provides technical guidance and mentorship to team members

* Communicates complex compiler and runtime concepts to varied audiences: SoC engineers, BU partners, and external ML developers
* Has meaningful influence on the Qualcomm AI Hub compiler roadmap, model catalog strategy, and cross-team runtime integration priorities

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
If you’re interested in advancing and applying mathematics, programming languages theory, advanced algorithms, and generative AI to program optimization for cutting-edge machine learning accelerators, then you really want to be talking to us!
The Compiler Labs unit in Qualcomm’s AI Software department is looking for ML Compiler engineers to join our team. We work tactically on improving existing ML compilers and strategically on developing new and innovative ML compilers.
Mapping ML algorithms to ML accelerators is currently one of the most interesting and challenging problems in compilers. Our compiler targets include the Qualcomm Hexagon Neural Signal Processor, Adreno GPUs, low-power ML accelerators, and CPU accelerators.
## What makes this work exciting right now
The complexity of modern ML architectures demands multi-tier compilers and new thinking about phase ordering. Polyhedral optimization is directly relevant to the deeply nested imperfect loop nests that characterize generative AI — and the implied execution model is pulling polyhedral techniques toward dataflow concepts and structured speculation. Communication-avoiding algorithms from high-performance computing are increasingly relevant. We are advancing compilers and intermediate representations that generalize cleanly across new innovations in ML model algorithms, so that our work compounds rather than restarts. We are working on correctness verification for programs built around quantized neural operators. And we are contributing to open-source dialect convergence in the LLVM and MLIR ecosystems — we have open-sourced our Hexagon-MLIR compiler and are actively developing it for Triton and Torch-MLIR flows.
## Generative AI is part of the work
Generative AI is reshaping compiler development itself — both as a tool that accelerates how engineers build compilers, and as a capability that lives inside compilers. Domain-specific languages are a particularly strong target for AI tools in compilation, because the compression, abstraction, and structure DSLs provide give AI models the right level of representation to operate on. We expect our engineers to be fluent in incorporating generative AI into the compiler development workflow and into compilers themselves.
## Our technical approach
Our approach emphasizes powerful representations for precisely and compactly modeling programs and the optimization challenges, and using advanced mathematics and algorithms for performing optimizations. We are also solid in using “old school” compiler technologies as they apply to contemporary ML challenges, and in meticulous software engineering to produce beautiful compilers. We are keen about seeing our compilers used and having large impact on Qualcomm’s business.
## Levels and locations
This job description spans multiple levels, from entry to experienced. Our team is a good home for compiler developers with advanced degrees, and we have solid mentoring and give substantial responsibility quickly to entry-level engineers.
We are looking for candidates to join our teams in New York City, Austin, San Diego, and Raleigh, NC. For experienced candidates, we may consider remote work arrangements.
## Responsibilities
* Work on a wide range of ML compilers
* Improve ML compiler optimization capabilities through benchmark analysis and profiling
* Innovate new ML compiler and optimization algorithms
* Incorporate generative AI into the compiler development workflow and into compilers themselves
* Upstream compiler algorithms to open-source compiler projects
* Author research publications and represent the company in conferences and industry forums
* For senior levels — lead and manage projects while doing substantial technical work
## Required
* Experience with compiler development and computer architecture
* ML experience
* A degree in the field of computer science or applied mathematics
* Experience with software engineering
* Solid intellectual ability, motivation, and a strong history of achievement
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
## Desired
* Experience with MLIR, MLIR dialects (LinAlg, Affine), PyTorch 2.0, TVM, Triton, and/or LLVM
* Experience incorporating generative AI into compiler development workflow (AI-assisted code generation, AI-assisted analysis, AI-assisted refactoring and review)
* Experience designing or extending DSLs as targets for AI-driven program synthesis
* ML applications and ML optimization experience
* ML architecture experience
* High-performance computing experience, including communication-avoiding algorithms
* Polyhedral compiler optimization experience
* Loop transformation and vectorization experience
* GPU programming, parallel programming experience
* General optimization experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.

About Qualcomm
Qualcomm relentlessly innovates transforming businesses, enriching lives and fortifying societies. Our solutions are pivotal in crafting a smarter, interconnected world. Building on our nearly 40-year history of era-defining technology breakthroughs, we deliver leading-edge AI, high performance, lower-power computing, and unrivaled connectivity. We’re proud to be the partner of choice to many of the world’s largest enterprises. Together with our ecosystem partners, we enable next-generation digital transformation. At Qualcomm, we are engineering human progress.
Join Us in Shaping the Future
At Qualcomm, we're committed to engineering human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. We're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to transform industries and improve lives. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. By joining our team, you'll be part of a community that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible in AI, computing, and connectivity. With a global footprint spanning over 30 countries, you'll have the chance to collaborate with diverse talent and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology.
Our early career programs are designed to attract inventive minds, offering a platform to contribute to our long-term innovation pipeline. You'll be part of a community that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Our programs provide real-world experience, technical skills, and professional development opportunities, empowering you to make a meaningful impact and achieve your career goals. Join us for our U.S. 2027 summer intern class!

Role Overview
As a Qualcomm Software Engineering Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of what exists and help establish the new standards for tomorrow. You will innovate as an equal contributor on teams of world-class engineers to develop, implement, and maintain software for the most complex wireless devices in the industry today. You will leverage your computer science or engineering degree to make an immediate impact on the software development life cycle of one of Qualcomm’s numerous software technologies.
This internship supports the Software Engineering track. Based on your resume you will be aligned to projects within this track.

* Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in computer engineering, computer science, electrical engineering, or a related field

General Summary:
This position can be based in Santa Clara or San Diego, California.
Qualcomm is transforming the compute industry by reimagining silicon and delivering cloud-scale, production-ready server platforms that prioritize performance determinism, energy efficiency, and operational simplicity at hyperscale. We are seeking a visionary VP, Engineering – Data Center CPU Software to lead the software, firmware, platform enablement, and system architecture required to scale Qualcomm’s server-class SoCs from silicon bring-up through hyperscaler deployment. This leader will drive software across CPU platform firmware, power and performance management, OS and hypervisor integration, BMC and platform management, telemetry, orchestration, verification and validation, release quality, and customer fleet readiness.

* Lead overall software architecture, development, integration, and execution for Qualcomm’s Data Center platforms, spanning server CPU, networking, platform management, and cluster-scale infrastructure.

Qualcomm Incorporated
## Job Area:
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > Data Science
General Summary:
The Staff Analytics Engineer (AI & Predictive) is a senior, hands‑on individual contributor responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing predictive analytics, traditional machine learning models, agentic AI systems, and Databricks‑native data applications that drive real business outcomes. This role operates at the intersection of data science, ML engineering, and full‑stack data application development, with a strong focus on production‑grade solutions.
This position requires deep expertise in classical ML techniques, agent‑based AI workflows, and Databricks application development, along with strong ownership of end‑to‑end delivery—from data preparation and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and user‑facing experiences.
This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).
This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.
Key Responsibilities
Traditional Machine Learning & Analytics
* Design, develop, and deploy traditional machine learning models, including regression, classification, clustering, time‑series forecasting, and anomaly detection.
* Perform feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance tuning on large‑scale enterprise datasets.
* Apply sound statistical and ML best practices to ensure model robustness, explainability, and business relevance.
Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation
* Design and implement agentic AI workflows, where autonomous or semi‑autonomous agents orchestrate data access, ML inference, decision logic, and actions.
* Build multi‑step agent pipelines that combine rules, ML models, and reasoning components to solve complex business problems.
* Integrate agentic systems with enterprise data, ML models, and applications to enable intelligent automation and decision support.
Databricks Application Development
* Design and develop Databricks‑native applications, including notebook‑based apps, interactive dashboards, and parameterized data/ML workflows.
* Build data and ML services/APIs leveraging Databricks, Python, and Lakehouse capabilities.
* Partner with analytics, BI, and application teams to embed ML insights, predictions, and agent outputs directly into Databricks apps and business workflows.
* Ensure Databricks apps meet performance, security, governance, and usability standards.
ML Engineering & Productionization
* Operationalize ML models and agentic workflows into production pipelines, ensuring scalability, reliability, and monitoring.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to leverage curated Lakehouse data, feature stores, and governed datasets.
* Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies to maintain long‑term model effectiveness.
Full‑Stack Data Enablement
* Develop end‑to‑end solutions that span data ingestion, modeling, ML inference, agent execution, and user‑facing applications.
* Translate business and analytical requirements into scalable, maintainable ML‑powered data products.
* Enable downstream consumption through Databricks apps, dashboards, APIs, and integrated enterprise applications.
Production Support & Operational Excellence
* Own production ML models, agentic systems, and Databricks applications, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and root‑cause analysis.
* Implement logging, alerting, and observability for models, agents, and applications.
* Drive continuous improvements in model accuracy, system reliability, and user experience.
Technical Leadership & Influence
* Serve as a technical authority in traditional ML, agentic AI, and Databricks application patterns.
* Influence architectural decisions, best practices, and technical standards across teams.
* Mentor peers and raise the bar on ML rigor, engineering quality, and production readiness.
Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience
* 5+ years of hands‑on experience in data science, applied machine learning, or ML engineering, with ownership of production systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python for ML development, data processing, and application logic.
* Deep experience with traditional ML techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time series).
* Proven experience building and deploying ML models in production environments.
* Hands‑on experience with Databricks, including Databricks application development (notebooks, workflows, dashboards, ML pipelines).
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, model evaluation, and explainability.
* Experience collaborating with data engineering, BI, and application teams.
Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Qualifications
* Experience designing and implementing agentic AI systems or autonomous decision‑making workflows.
* Familiarity with Lakehouse architectures, feature stores, and ML lifecycle management.
* Experience with ML Ops practices, CI/CD, model monitoring, and retraining pipelines.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and scalable ML infrastructure.
* Experience embedding ML and agent outputs into enterprise applications or analytics platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, access controls, and secure ML deployment.
What Defines Success at the Staff Level
* Independently delivers high‑impact ML models, agentic AI workflows, and Databricks applications.
* Bridges data science, ML engineering, and full‑stack data app development.
* Influences architecture, standards, and technical direction beyond assigned projects.
* Acts as a trusted technical partner to business, analytics, and engineering stakeholders.
* Raises organizational maturity in traditional ML, agentic AI adoption, and production ML practices.

## Job Area:

General Summary:
Qualcomm AI Research is looking for world-class researchers in deep learning to join a high-caliber team of engineers inventing machine-learning technology to provide best-in-class solutions while running with the most efficient use of power, memory, and computation.
Members of our team are part of a multi-disciplinary core research group within Qualcomm which spans software, hardware, and systems. Our members contribute technology deployed worldwide by partnering with our business teams across mobile, compute, automotive, cloud, and IOT. We also perform and publish state-of-the-art research on a wide range of topics in machine-learning, ranging from general theory to techniques that enable deployment on resource-constrained devices. Our research team has demonstrated first-in-the-world research and proof-of-concepts in areas such model efficiency, neural video codecs, generative ai, video semantic segmentation, federated learning, and wireless RF sensing, to name a few. We work to then convert our research and industry state-of-the-art methods. Please see our AI focus page at https://qualcomm.com/ai for more details.
Role responsibility can include both applied and fundamental research in the field of machine learning with development focus in one or many of the following areas:
• Drives systems innovations for model efficiency advancement on device as well as in the cloud. This includes model compression, model sparsity, quantization optimization methods, plus unified optimization of models and their implementation on-target to balance memory, speed, and power.
• Conducts fundamental machine learning research to create new models or new training methods in various technology areas, e.g., large language models, deep generative models (transformers, state-space networks, diffusion networks, VAEs, etc.), reasoning models, agentic frameworks, and reinforcement learning techniques.
• Performs advanced platform research to enable new machine learning compute paradigms, e.g., compute in memory, on-device learning/training, edge-cloud distributed/federated learning, quantum machine learning, causal and language-based reasoning.
• Creates new machine learning models for advanced use cases that achieve state-of-the-art performance and beyond. The use cases can broadly include computer vision, audio, speech, NLP, image, video, power management, wireless, graphics, and chip design.
• Design, develop & test software for machine learning frameworks that optimize models to run efficiently on edge devices. Candidate is expected to have strong interest and deep passion on making leading-edge deep learning algorithms work on mobile/embedded platforms for the benefit of end users.
• Research, design, develop, enhance, and implement different components of machine learning compiler for HW Accelerators.
• Design, implement and train DL/RL algorithms in high-level languages/frameworks.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
Qualifications:
· PhD in AI, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or MS with 4+ years of machine learning research, or related work experience.
· Strong background in computer science and deep learning basics
· Strong programming skills in Python and PyTorch. Proficiency in designing and implementing complex training and evaluation pipelines.
· Exceptional analytical, development, debugging and problem solving skills

· Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communications skills

General Summary:
Qualcomm's Multimedia R&D Group is seeking candidates to join its world-class Speech team developing novel technologies enabling the future of real-time communication and collaboration. We conduct fundamental research inventing new algorithms, models, and systems that allow people to engage with one another and their devices in natural ways through speech and gestures over wireless communication devices and networks. Our multi-disciplinary research spans multiple communication modalities and feeds into Qualcomm’s industry-leading businesses across mobile, XR, Compute, IoT, and Automotive. Our technologies have been incorporated into international standards and deployed in mobile devices around the world. We are seeking candidates with technical excellence in Digital Signal Processing (DSP), Machine Learning, and Speech/Audio Processing, with the creativity and initiative to apply their technical knowledge to exciting new modalities and platforms for human-to-human and human-to-machine communication.

The selected candidate will have responsibilities in one or more of the following areas:
* Fundamental research in the fields of signal processing and machine learning
* Advanced use cases for human interaction that combine communication modalities from areas such as speech, audio (including 3D), natural language, video, computer vision, and graphics

* Programming skills in C/C++ and Python, and experience in Windows or Unix/Linux development environments

##
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
## Job Area:
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Cloud Architect
General Summary:
Qualcomm IT is seeking a Platform Engineer to design, build, and govern the GitOps release process, CI/CD automation, and developer tooling for our internal developer platform built on EKS. Working as part of the broader Cloud Team, you will shape how platform changes are built, versioned, promoted, and released, and help drive the delivery practices that keep the platform team shipping predictably. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role for an IT architect who pairs deep technical execution with the ability to define standards independently and drive their adoption across teams without direct authority.
This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).
This role is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.
What You Will Own:
• GitOps Release Process & Governance: Design, implement, and govern the platform GitOps release process using Argo CD; define multi-environment promotion workflows, deployment guardrails, and release documentation; independently set GitOps standards and drive their adoption across platform and application teams.
• CI/CD Automation: Own platform infrastructure CI/CD workflow definitions and pipeline implementation using GitHub Actions; build pipelines that integrate building, linting, testing, DevSecOps scanning, and Argo CD delivery; continuously reduce release lead time and manual toil.
• Branching, Versioning & Repository Automation: Define and maintain the platform branching strategy and version tagging scheme; implement repository and pull request automation using gitStream to streamline code review, routing, and merge workflows.
• Developer Experience & Tooling: Treat the platform as a product; build self-service "paved road" templates, tooling, and documentation that reduce friction for internal teams adopting the platform; gather user feedback and track adoption with measurable outcomes.
• Process & Ways of Working: Help drive the platform team's agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, sprint goal tracking, daily standups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives; create, prioritize, and delegate backlog work across the team; bring process formality that improves delivery predictability. Opportunity to serve as Scrum Master for candidates with that experience.
• Infrastructure as Code: Design and build Terraform modules, state management, and multi-environment patterns; apply and extend the reference implementations and guardrails that let engineering teams deliver infrastructure consistently and safely.
• Kubernetes Platform Engineering (EKS): Contribute to cluster provisioning and lifecycle management in multi-tenant environments, including autoscaling with Karpenter, add-on lifecycle management, and cluster upgrades; make sure release processes support safe, repeatable rollout of cluster changes.
• Reliability, Observability & Security: Continuously evaluate and tune platform services to improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency; apply observability standards using Datadog and Prometheus/Grafana to pipeline and release health; implement secure-by-default delivery patterns with Kyverno and Cilium in partnership with security stakeholders.
• Cross-Team Influence & Communication: Communicate release plans, process changes, and delivery health to IT leadership and stakeholder teams; represent the platform in architecture and change reviews; author technical design docs and proposals, validate them with Cloud Team architects, and drive implementation through delivery; partner with Cloud Team architects and leadership to align CI/CD and GitOps capabilities with the multi-year platform roadmap.
• Technical Talent Development: Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on GitOps, CI/CD, and delivery practices; participate in interview loops and help uphold the hiring bar.
• Operational Excellence: Contribute to runbook standards and incident response practices; lead resolution of release and pipeline-related incidents and drive corrective actions afterward. On-call participation is required, including potential 24/7 coverage.
Minimum Qualifications:
• 7+ years of IT-related experience with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Applied Mathematics, or Engineering OR 10+ years without, with demonstrated progression from technical execution to team-level technical leadership
• 3+ years operating Kubernetes in production; hands-on EKS experience including cluster lifecycle and multi-environment operations
• Proven experience designing and governing GitOps release processes, including branching strategies, multi-environment promotion, and release versioning/tagging
• Advanced CI/CD expertise using GitHub Actions or similar to build pipelines integrating building, linting, testing, DevSecOps, and Argo CD integration
• Strong Terraform expertise including module development, state management, and multi-environment patterns
• Strong AWS expertise across networking, IAM, and the EKS ecosystem
• Track record of driving technical standards and adoption across teams without direct authority
• Strong Linux and distributed systems troubleshooting skills across Kubernetes, networking, and AWS
• Experience with Helm/Kustomize, Kubernetes networking fundamentals, and Cilium
• Clear written and verbal communication skills across engineering and leadership audiences
• Platform product thinking, treating developer experience as a product with measurable outcomes
Highly Desired:
• Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKAD/CKS) and/or AWS DevOps Engineer Professional / Solutions Architect certification
• Experience leading agile/Scrum delivery for an engineering team as Scrum Master or equivalent; Scrum certification (CSM/PSM) a plus
• Experience with gitStream or similar repository automation, and automated release/versioning tools (e.g., semantic versioning, release-please, semantic-release)
• Experience with Karpenter, Kyverno policy-as-code, and Crossplane concepts
• Demonstrated success building self-service "paved road" platform capabilities

We are dedicated to transforming the industry by reimagining silicon and developing next-generation computing platforms.
