General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G, ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform wireless innovation into world-changing technologies and products.
The RF System Test team is responsible for validating the modem, RF, and antenna subsystems that power cellular connectivity across billions of devices worldwide, spanning smartphones, automotive, IoT, fixed wireless access, and next-generation 5G/6G platforms.
As an RF System Test Engineer, you will define, automate, execute, debug, and analyze validation strategies for advanced wireless technologies including 5G NR and emerging cellular features. You will work across modem software, RF hardware, system design, and test infrastructure to ensure product quality, standards compliance, and successful customer deployments.
This role is increasingly AI-native. Engineers are expected to leverage AI-assisted workflows for test generation, log analysis, defect triage, root-cause investigation, and automation development to accelerate validation cycles and improve engineering productivity.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
* Define, implement, and execute RF system validation strategies across modem software, RF hardware, and integrated platform solutions.
* Develop and maintain automated test frameworks used to verify wireless functionality, performance, stability, and standards compliance.
* Analyze test results and identify root causes of failures spanning modem software, RF subsystems, test infrastructure, and hardware interactions.
* Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and integration teams to drive issue resolution and product readiness.
* Design and improve automated regression and qualification methodologies that support rapid development and high-quality software releases.
* Interpret and apply 3GPP specifications to ensure complete and accurate test coverage for new features and technologies.
* Execute and analyze RF measurements including transmitter performance, receiver performance, spectrum emissions, waveform quality, mobility, and interoperability testing.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test development, log analysis, issue triage, coverage assessment, and root-cause investigations.
* Develop scripts and tools that improve test efficiency, reporting, data analysis, and engineering workflows.
* Evaluate emerging modem and RF features and define appropriate validation methodologies to ensure scalable, reusable test coverage across multiple products.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes, automation infrastructure, and AI-assisted validation methodologies.
* Share expertise and contribute to the growth of engineering best practices across the team.

* Experience with 3GPP cellular technologies
* Experience with RF measurements including power, spectrum, emissions, receiver sensitivity, and modulation quality.

* Experience defining test plans, methodologies, and coverage strategies.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with demonstrated ability to root-cause complex system-level failures.
* Experience developing automation solutions using Python and/or C++.
* Familiarity with large-scale automated test environments and continuous integration workflows.
* Experience with log analysis, issue tracking, test reporting, and quality metrics.
AI-Native Engineering
* Demonstrated interest in applying AI-assisted tools to improve engineering productivity, automation, analysis, and debugging workflows.

* Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated output and validate technical correctness.

* Cellular protocol analysis and diagnostic tools

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
Job Overview/Summary: Senior automotive software engineer with 5+ years of experience focused on Android Automotive, software development, system integration testing, debugging, validation, and integration of next-generation automotive experience platforms.
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what is possible to enable next-generation experiences and drive digital transformation toward a smarter, more connected future. The Automotive Experience Platform team within Qualcomm’s automotive business unit builds solutions that showcase future technologies in the automotive industry. The team highlights upcoming automotive technologies from Qualcomm and its partners at global trade shows and in private demonstrations for key industry stakeholders.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Automotive Experience Platform team, you will design, develop, debug, validate, and integrate Android and automotive software features that demonstrate future vehicle experiences. You will work hands-on across development and system integration testing activities, including triaging complex issues, analyzing logs, debugging software across Android, Linux, QNX, middleware, and embedded interfaces, and driving issues to closure. You will collaborate with platform teams, UX teams, system integration teams, and partner organizations to support rapid prototyping, demo readiness, and reliable execution for customer and trade show showcases. This role is well suited for an engineer who can both build software and perform deep SIT-level debugging in a fast-paced automotive environment.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
• 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications and Skills:
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, in Android, Android Automotive, embedded systems, or automotive software platforms.
* Strong understanding of Android framework, Android services, application lifecycle, IPC mechanisms, permissions, build systems, debugging tools, and system-level behavior.
* BSP Integration, Performance analysis, Key Performance Indicators (KPI) management (multi virtual machine)
* Strong hands-on programming experience in Java or Kotlin, with solid working knowledge of C/C++
* Compute platform architecture (SoC, GPU/DSP, accelerators) – Hypervisor /Virtual Machine
* Embedded SW stacks (OS such as QNX/Linux/Android, middleware, frameworks, toolchains, AUTOSAR (Classic/Adaptive))
* ADAS sensor integration: Cameras/RADARs/Ultrasound Sensors/
* Experience with Android Automotive OS, automotive middleware, vehicle interfaces, CAN, SOME/IP, MQTT or other in-vehicle communication technologies is highly preferred.
* Experience performing system integration testing, issue triage, log analysis, root-cause analysis, and debugging across software, middleware, operating system, and hardware interfaces.
* Strong experience with Linux and QNX operating systems, embedded software environments, and cross-platform integration workflows.
* Strong software design, development, unit testing, debugging, validation, and integration skills.
* Experience with source control, issue tracking, CI/CD workflows, release processes, and collaborative software development practices.
* Ability to work independently, drive technical issues to closure, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering, UX, platform, and partner teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation of technical findings, integration steps, defects, and validation results.
* Experience with Qt, IoT, cloud-connected vehicle experiences, or AI-assisted software development tools is a plus.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, modify, validate, and debug Android, Android Automotive, embedded, edge, and utility software applications for automotive experience platforms.
* Develop and integrate software features that support concept vehicle demonstrations, prototype features, customer showcases, and global trade show experiences.
* Perform system integration testing and SIT-level debugging by analyzing logs, traces, crashes, timing issues, interface failures, and end-to-end system behavior across multiple software and hardware layers.
* Perform system characterization by executing envelope and stress use‑case tests that simulate worst‑case workload conditions, validating that the Flex Platform solution provides sufficient performance headroom to support OEM‑specific extensions and future scalability.
* Drive root-cause analysis and issue closure for complex integration problems involving Android framework, applications, middleware, vehicle interfaces, operating systems, and embedded components.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, define technical approaches, estimate work, manage dependencies, and deliver high-quality software within project schedules.
* Support software bring-up, integration, validation, and demo readiness activities on target hardware, concept vehicles, and automotive development platforms.
* Contribute to software architecture and design discussions, while ensuring practical implementation choices that support rapid prototyping and reliable demonstrations.
* Mentor junior engineers, share debugging practices, review code, and promote engineering quality across development and integration activities.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation for software design, integration procedures, debugging findings, known issues, and validation results.
Success in This Role:
A successful candidate will be a hands-on senior engineer who can move confidently between software development and system integration testing. The candidate should have strong Android and automotive software experience, the ability to debug complex cross-layer issues, and the ownership mindset to drive problems from initial triage through root cause, fix validation, and closure. This person should communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams, and help deliver reliable, high-visibility prototype and demonstration software in a fast-paced automotive environment.

General Summary:
Qualcomm is a global leader in intelligent computing, connectivity, and edge AI technologies. Our Snapdragon platforms power the next generation of mobile, compute, automotive, XR, IoT, and connected devices. As part of Qualcomm’s software organization, you will work with a world-class team of hardware, systems, AI, and software engineers to define and deliver the future of always-on, context-aware, and agentic AI experiences on power-constrained edge devices.
The Ambient Perception Platform team is responsible for the architecture, development, integration, optimization, and commercialization of the Ambient Perception Platform across Android, Linux, Windows, XR, automotive, and IoT platforms powered by Qualcomm SoCs. Our mission is to enable intelligent, low-power, context-aware experiences that continuously understand user intent, environmental context, and device state while maintaining industry-leading battery efficiency and privacy.
We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Engineers to lead the architecture and evolution of next-generation Ambient Perception frameworks, context awareness engines, multimodal data collection systems, secure data delivery and storage architectures, and low-power AI runtime platforms. This role offers an opportunity to influence the software architecture that powers future AI assistants, proactive experiences, multimodal sensing systems, autonomous edge intelligence solutions, and heterogeneous computing frameworks that operate efficiently across CPU, DSP, NPU across Qualcomm’s product portfolio.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
• 2+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 8–12+ years of combined software architecture, embedded systems development, and platform integration experience.
* Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
* Experience developing software on ARM-based and heterogeneous SoC architectures.
* Proven experience leading architecture design, technical roadmaps, and cross-functional engineering initiatives.
* Experience architecting SDKs, middleware, or platform frameworks for AI-enabled applications.
* Strong understanding of Ambient Perception, context-aware computing, and multimodal sensing systems.

General Summary:
LLM Serving Engineer (Cloud AI Engineering)
Qualcomm is utilizing its traditional strengths in digital wireless technologies to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. We are investing in several supporting technologies including Deep Learning. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team is developing hardware and software solutions for Inference Acceleration.
We are hiring LLM Serving Engineers at multiple levels to join our dynamic, collaborative team. This role spans the full product lifecycle—from cutting-edge research and development to commercial deployment—and demands strategic thinking, strong execution, and excellent communication skills.
This role involves the following activities:
* Building a scalable LLM inference platform using inference techniques (e.g. disaggregated serving and KV-Cache management, advanced parallelism, speculative algorithms, model optimization, specialized kernels).
* Contribute to the development of LLM Serving packages (e.g. vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Triton-Inference server, Dynamo, LLM-d).
* Work closely with customers to drive solutions by collaborating with internal compiler, firmware and platform teams.
* Work at the forefront of GenAI by understanding advanced algorithms (e.g. attention mechanisms, MoEs) and numerics to identify new optimization opportunities.
* Drive efficient serving through smart autoscaling, load balancing and routing.
* Engage with open-source serving communities to evolve the framework.
Candidates for this position will demonstrate the following:
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following LLM serving/Orchestration packages (Triton-Inference Server, vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, llm-d, KServe, LMCache, MoonCake)
* Deep understanding of foundational LLMs, VLMs, SLMs, transformer-based architectures.
* Strong experience in developing language models using PyTorch.
* Strong computer science fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, parallel and distributed programming.
* Understanding of computer architecture, ML accelerators, in-memory processing and distributed systems.
* Strong Python development skills for large-scale projects with passion for software engineering.
* Experience in analyzing, profiling, and optimizing deep learning workloads.
* Proactive learning about the latest inference optimization techniques.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
* MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

* Open-source contribution to any GenAI package.
* Experience architecting and developing large-scale distributed systems.

* Knowledge of torch.compile or torchDynamo

General Summary:
General Summary:
As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. We are seeking a results-driven Principal Engineer to lead our Home and Life, Video Collaboration Segments in the Consumer Processor Engineering division. In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the strategic vision, development, and execution for the Retail, Home & Life and Video Collaboration segments.
You will serve as a key bridge between technical execution teams and global customers, collaborating closely with Product Management to translate market needs into comprehensive, end-to-end technology solutions. This is an opportunity to shape the future of consumer processor applications in a high-growth IoT landscape. You operate with minimal direction, solve ambiguous and cross domain problems, and influence technical decisions across multiple product generations.
This role is not focused on people management, but on technical leadership at scale owning end-to-end architecture, setting engineering standards, and unblocking complex system level challenges across hardware, software, and product teams.
Scope & Impact
At the Principal level, you are expected to:
* Strategic Roadmap & Execution: Define and execute a robust strategic roadmap for the Home and Life, Video Collaboration segment, ensuring alignment with company-wide IoT objectives and product group requirements. Drive cross team technical alignment and influence roadmap decisions.
* Customer & Product Synergy: Partner directly with customers and product management to identify segment-specific needs; translate these into technical requirements and map them to appropriate SoC (System-on-Chip) and software platforms.

Own system level architecture for major subsystems Camera, Display, Audio, Video, Security, Boot, Storage and Peripherals.

Drives complete verification for component and chipset KPIs (performance, power, and quality); directs teams conducting hardware, software, or system-level testing, verification, and validation based on project plans and specifications.

* Talent & Culture Excellence: Foster a culture of engineering excellence, challenging the status quo, continuous improvement, innovation, and calculated risk-taking.
Level of Responsibility:

* Tasks often require multiple steps which can be performed in various orders; extensive planning, problem-solving, and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively.

* 3+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with executive leadership.
* 2+ years of experience balancing tradeoffs between product KPIs and costs.
* 2+ years of experience managing project costs.

This role is critical to enabling enterprise analytics, BI, AI/ML, and data‑driven applications, with deep expertise in Databricks, Python, Spark, and Databricks application development.
This position requires strong end‑to‑end ownership of data engineering and data app solutions, production‑grade engineering rigor, and the ability to collaborate across platform, analytics, and application teams.
This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).

7+ years of IT-related work experience without a Bachelor’s degree.

Data Engineering & Development

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
Seeking an experienced Embedded ML Staff Engineer focused on Snapdragon Mobile products. As a senior individual contributor on the team working on Mobile Handset software architecture and system design and development, you will analyze requirements and design/implement solutions for new use-cases and features. You will drive technical initiatives to evolve Snapdragon Mobile AI software, helping deliver performance and power enhancements into the SW/HW stacks and tools of state-of-the-art machine learning solutions. You will work closely with architects, development leads, software and hardware engineers, project engineers, and product managers.
Ideal candidate has strong experience with Mobile SW design and deployment, system SW performance optimization, benchmarking, and performance breakdown analysis with CPU, GPU, NPU, and knowledge of state of the art in AI for one or more of the domains such as Computer Vision, Audio, Generative AI. Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, LLMs/SLMs, and embedded ML at the system level on resource-constrained devices, including heterogeneous compute placement across CPU/GPU/NPU and context/perception pipelines that feed those experiences, is a strong plus. Experience with Mobile platforms is highly desirable.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are important. Strong collaboration and mentorship skills are a plus.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
Responsibilities
* Design and implement architecture for complex AI features and experiences within your subsystem for Snapdragon Mobile products; propose architecture improvements.
* Research and collaborate cross-functionally to help define requirements; build hands-on prototypes.
* Design and implement on-device agentic experience components, including context and memory management, perception (e.g., screen/scene understanding, sensor fusion), and heterogeneous compute placement for LLM/SLM workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU under tight power, thermal, and memory budgets.
* Implement closed-loop, telemetry-driven resource scheduling components for heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/NPU), re-evaluating workload placement against live power, thermal, and SLA signals.
* Implement memory and model-state lifecycle management for on-device LLM/SLM serving -- including KV-cache and context-state caching, eviction, paging, and reuse/sharing across sessions under tight device memory budgets.
* Evaluate and help architect around memory bandwidth and data-movement constraints (e.g., high-bandwidth memory, on-chip interconnects) to maximize achievable AI throughput and efficiency on constrained silicon.
* Serve as a technical resource in design reviews; recommend improvements aligned to business and customer needs.
* Collaborate with external partners on subsystem implementation plans and milestones.
* Stay current on AI and Mobile industry trends, competitors' products, and advances in various engineering fields; share expertise within the team.
* Contribute technical input and trend analysis to roadmap discussions led by architecture and product leadership.
Preferred Qualifications
* Excellent understanding of AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). Experience with large language models/foundational models and small language models (SLMs), including LoRA/adapter-based fine-tuning and on-device personalization techniques, MCP's a plus.
* Experience with agentic AI architectures -- planning, tool-use/orchestration, context and memory management -- and their deployment on resource-constrained embedded devices.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and implementing SW frameworks for complex heterogeneous or multi-processor systems, including runtime placement of ML/agentic workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU.
* Experience designing graph-based (DAG) or state-machine-driven schedulers for multi-workload resource allocation across heterogeneous compute, with closed-loop adaptation to live system telemetry.
* Experience with resource allocation across multiple concurrent AI workloads/agents competing for shared compute and memory, not just single-model placement.
* Background in closed-loop or control-systems thinking (feedback-driven scheduling, adaptive/self-correcting systems) is a plus.
* Experience with embedded ML at the system level -- model deployment, scheduling, and lifecycle management under tight memory, power, and thermal constraints on mobile/embedded platforms.
* Experience with LLM/SLM serving internals -- KV-cache and model-state management, paging/eviction strategies, and state sharing or reuse across concurrent sessions or agents.
* Good Understanding of complete AI Software stack and familiarity with AI hardware acceleration technologies.
* Understanding of memory subsystem and interconnect bandwidth (e.g., HBM/LPDDR, cache hierarchies, NPU memory architecture) and how bandwidth -- not just compute -- bottlenecks AI inference performance; experience architecting to minimize redundant data movement.
* Experience in modeling AI networks and workloads to extract performance and power estimates, and converting that into optimization.
* Experience with context and perception pipelines (sensor fusion, screen/scene understanding, multimodal context) that power personalized or agentic on-device experiences.
* Strong background in algorithm development, performance analysis using profiling tools, and algorithmic modification methods for performance improvement.
* Knowledge of state of the art in AI for one or more domains such as Computer Vision, Audio, Generative AI.
* Knowledge of Mobile platforms, Android framework, Embedded system implementations.
* Strong software engineering principles.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, Python. Understanding Typescript, Java, Kotlin is a plus. The ability to use agentic tooling for development is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical and technical stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers; ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with the ability to think strategically and drive innovative solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to learn, think and adapt in a fast-changing environment.
* Familiarity with software development methodologies, version control systems, and agile project management practices.
* 5-8 years of experience in High-Performance Computing System Engineering or Software, with 2+ years in AI system optimization.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.

Company:

## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
AI Performance Engineer (Cloud AI Engineering)
Qualcomm is utilizing its traditional strengths in digital wireless technologies to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. We are investing in several supporting technologies including Deep Learning. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team is developing hardware and software solutions for Inference Acceleration.
We are hiring an AI Performance Engineers at multiple levels to join our dynamic, collaborative team. This role spans the full product lifecycle—from cutting-edge research and development to commercial deployment—and demands strategic thinking, strong execution, and excellent communication skills.
This role involves the following activities:
* Convert, optimize and deploy models for efficient inference using PyTorch, ONNX.
* Work at the forefront of GenAI by understanding advanced algorithms (e.g. attention mechanisms, MoEs) and numerics to identify new optimization opportunities.
* Performance analysis and optimization of LLM, VLM, and diffusion models for inference. Scale performance for throughput and latency constraints.
* Mapping the next generation AI workloads on top of current and future hardware designs.
* Work closely with customers to drive solutions by collaborating with internal compiler, firmware and platform teams.
* Analyze complex performance or stability issues to work towards final root cause of underlying problems.
* Create engineering solutions to deliver continuous insights into performance of AI workloads guiding the improvements over time.
* Design and implement high-level kernels, e.g. in Triton, with a focus on generating efficient, low-level code.
Candidates for this position will demonstrate the following:
* Hands-on experience in building and optimizing language models, notably in PyTorch, ONNX, preferably in production-grade environments.
* Deep understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms and performance trade-offs.
* Experience in workload mapping strategies exhibiting sharding or various parallelisms.
* Strong Python programming skills.
* Proactive learning about the latest inference optimization techniques.
* Understanding of computer architecture, ML accelerators, in-memory processing and distributed systems.
* Strong communication, problem-solving skills and ability to learn and work effectively in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
* MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Bonus Skills:
* Background in neural network operators and mathematical operations, including linear algebra and math libraries.
* Understanding of machine learning compilers.
* Experience in converging accuracy and its evaluation methods.
* Knowledge of torch.compile or torchDynamo.
* PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Machine Learning

## Job Area:

General Summary:
Qualcomm's Multimedia R&D and Standards Group is seeking a candidate for the position of Video Compression Research Engineer with a focus on Learning-Based Video Compression. You will join a world-renowned team of video compression experts developing next-generation neural video coding technologies and contributing to future video compression standards.
The ideal candidate will be a highly self-directed individual with strong creative and analytical skills, and a passion for machine learning, neural compression, and video coding. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking advances in neural video compression while collaborating with experts in machine learning, computer vision, multimedia systems, and video coding standards.
We are considering candidates with various levels of experience. We are flexible on location and open to hiring globally, with preferred locations in the USA, Germany, China, and the UK. Qualcomm may provide relocation support for qualified candidates who wish to relocate to one of these locations.
Responsibilities:
* Contribute to the conception, development, implementation, and optimization of novel learning-based video compression algorithms, including neural video coding, learned motion representation, and entropy modeling.
* Evaluate and improve neural and hybrid compression systems using state-of-the-art machine learning techniques and rate-distortion optimization.
* Represent Qualcomm in related standardization forums including JVET, MPEG Video, and ITU-T/VCEG.
* Document and present new algorithms and implementations through standards contributions, patent applications, conference papers, presentations, and journal publications.
Ideal candidate would have the skills/experience below:
* Developed innovative machine learning algorithms, preferably related to learned image/video compression, computer vision, or generative AI.
* Knowledge of the theory, algorithms, and techniques used in video coding, rate-distortion optimization, and neural compression.
* Experience with video compression standards such as VVC/H.266, HEVC/H.265, AV1, or emerging neural video coding technologies.

* Excellent programming skills including Python and C/C++, combined with experience using machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Researcher
General Summary:
Qualcomm AI Research is seeking world-class researchers to help push the boundaries of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Our team pioneers new algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art while delivering exceptional performance with unprecedented power, memory, and computational efficiency.
Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across algorithms, software, hardware, and systems. We pursue fundamental and applied research, from foundational theories and novel learning algorithms to efficient AI systems deployed on resource-constrained devices. Working closely with Qualcomm's business and engineering teams, we translate research breakthroughs into technologies deployed worldwide across mobile, compute, automotive, robotics, cloud, XR, and IoT platforms, while publishing at leading AI conferences.
Our team has demonstrated world-first research breakthroughs and proof-of-concepts across model efficiency, representation learning, perception and understanding, generative and foundation models, reasoning and agentic intelligence, and embodied and physical AI. Our research contributions have earned numerous best paper awards, major research competition wins, and top rankings on AI and computer vision benchmarks. We also translate these breakthroughs into highly optimized AI models, end-to-end workflows, and developer tools for Qualcomm platforms, making many innovations accessible to all. Explore our research and innovations:
* Research Breakthroughs and Demonstrations
* Qualcomm AI Research Publications and Innovations
* Qualcomm AI Hub: Optimized Models and Workflows
Role Responsibilities:
Research interns will contribute to fundamental and applied research in artificial intelligence and machine learning, developing novel algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art. Research opportunities span a broad range of areas, including:
* Generative AI and Foundation Models: Large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, vision-language models (VLMs), vision-language-action models (VLAs), world models, and generative modeling for language, image, video, audio, and 3D content. Research topics include diffusion and autoregressive models, mixture-of-experts, parallel decoding, long-context modeling, and knowledge distillation.
* Agentic AI and Reasoning: Autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, reasoning, planning, and verification; memory management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), inference-time optimization, robustness, alignment, AI safety, and hallucination mitigation.
* Efficient and Scalable AI: Novel neural architectures, efficient attention mechanisms, transformers, state-space models, and recurrent networks; model compression, pruning, quantization, neural architecture search, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and efficient training and inference. Research also includes on-device AI, edge-cloud learning, distributed training, hardware-aware optimization, and compiler and kernel optimizations.
* Learning, Perception, and Embodied AI: Self-supervised, reinforcement, imitation, contrastive, and continual learning; few-shot learning, personalization, domain adaptation, and uncertainty estimation. Applications include computer vision, 3D perception, neural rendering, speech AI, autonomous driving, robotics, embodied intelligence, and human-AI interfaces.
Depending on the research project, internship responsibilities may include:
* Conducting original research, developing novel machine learning algorithms and architectures, and designing, training, and evaluating AI models to advance the state of the art.
* Developing efficient AI systems and software frameworks, including optimization for mobile, edge, and cloud platforms.
* Exploring emerging computing paradigms, including hardware-software co-design, compute-in-memory, and distributed or federated learning.
* Collaborating with researchers and engineers to prototype, validate, and communicate research findings, with opportunities to contribute to scientific publications and technology transfer.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
• 6+ months of experience developing and/or optimizing machine learning models, systems, platforms, or methods.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Engineering
General Summary:
Seeking an experienced Embedded ML SW Architect focused on Snapdragon Mobile products. As a senior member of the team working on Mobile Handset software architecture and software system design, you will have the opportunity to analyze requirements and architect/develop high level designs for new Use-cases and features. You will also drive technical initiatives to evolve Snapdragon Mobile AI software, helping to drive performance and power enhancements into the SW and HW stacks and SW tools of state-of-the-art machine learning solutions on the Snapdragon Mobile platform. You will work closely with development leads, software and hardware architects, project engineers, product managers, customer engineers, OEMs, and external partners.
Ideal candidate has extensive experience with Mobile SW architecture and deployment, system SW performance optimization, benchmarking, and performance breakdown analysis with CPU, GPU, NPU, and knowledge of state of the art in AI for one or more of the domains such as Computer Vision, Audio, Generative AI. Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, LLMs/SLMs, and embedded ML at the system level on resource-constrained devices, including heterogeneous compute placement across CPU/GPU/NPU and context/perception pipelines that feed those experiences, is a strong plus. Experience with Mobile Platforms is highly desirable.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are critical. In this cross functional role, excellent people and leadership skills are key.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 7+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 6+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
Responsibilities
* Develop architecture for complex features and experiences built around AI for Snapdragon Mobile products; recommend architecture enhancements.
* Independently research and work cross-functionally to define requirements. Hands on prototype development.
* Architect on-device agentic experiences, including context and memory management, perception (e.g., screen/scene understanding, sensor fusion), and heterogeneous compute placement for LLM/SLM workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU under tight power, thermal, and memory budgets.
* Architect closed-loop, telemetry-driven resource scheduling for heterogeneous compute (CPU/GPU/NPU) -- continuously re-evaluating and re-placing workloads against live power, thermal, and SLA signals rather than deciding placement once statically.
* Design memory and model-state lifecycle management for on-device LLM/SLM serving -- including KV-cache and context-state caching, eviction, paging, and reuse/sharing across sessions under tight device memory budgets.
* Evaluate and architect around memory bandwidth and data-movement constraints (e.g., high-bandwidth memory, on-chip interconnects) to maximize achievable AI throughput and efficiency on constrained silicon.
* Serve as a technical expert in developing and commercializing solutions; participate in design reviews and recommend improvements to ensure alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Influence and negotiate with external partners to gain buy-in for ideas and align on project and subsystem implementation plans and milestones to ensure the needs of all stakeholders are met.
* Act as a technical expert on AI and Mobile industry trends, competitors' products, and advances in various engineering fields; share expertise within and/or across teams.
* Leverages technical expertise to identify trends and define future solutions by contributing to discussions on the short - and long-term strategic direction of the product/technology roadmaps.
Preferred Qualifications
* Excellent understanding of AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch). Experience with large language models/foundational models and small language models (SLMs), including LoRA/adapter-based fine-tuning and on-device personalization techniques, MCP's a plus.
* Experience with agentic AI architectures -- planning, tool-use/orchestration, context and memory management -- and their deployment on resource-constrained embedded devices.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and implementing SW frameworks for complex heterogeneous or multi-processor systems, including runtime placement of ML/agentic workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU.
* Experience designing graph-based (DAG) or state-machine-driven schedulers for multi-workload resource allocation across heterogeneous compute, with closed-loop adaptation to live system telemetry.
* Experience with resource allocation across multiple concurrent AI workloads/agents competing for shared compute and memory, not just single-model placement.
* Background in closed-loop or control-systems thinking (feedback-driven scheduling, adaptive/self-correcting systems) is a plus.
* Experience with embedded ML at the system level, model deployment, scheduling, and lifecycle management under tight memory, power, and thermal constraints on mobile/embedded platforms.
* Experience with LLM/SLM serving internals -- KV-cache and model-state management, paging/eviction strategies, and state sharing or reuse across concurrent sessions or agents.
* Good Understanding of complete AI Software stack and familiarity with AI hardware acceleration technologies.
* Understanding of memory subsystem and interconnect bandwidth (e.g., HBM/LPDDR, cache hierarchies, NPU memory architecture) and how bandwidth -- not just compute -- bottlenecks AI inference performance; experience architecting to minimize redundant data movement.
* Experience in modeling AI networks and workloads to extract performance and power estimates, and converting that into optimization.
* Experience with context and perception pipelines (sensor fusion, screen/scene understanding, multimodal context) that power personalized or agentic on-device experiences.
* Strong background in algorithm development, performance analysis using profiling tools, and algorithmic modification methods for performance improvement.
* Knowledge of state of the art in AI for one or more domains such as Computer Vision, Audio, Generative AI.
* Knowledge of Mobile platforms, Android framework, Embedded system implementations.
* Strong software engineering principles.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, Python. Understanding Typescript, Java, Kotlin is a plus. The ability to use agentic tooling for development is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical and technical stakeholders.
* Strong leadership abilities to motivate and guide development teams.
* Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with the ability to think strategically and drive innovative solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to learn, think and adapt in a fast-changing environment.
* Familiarity with software development methodologies, version control systems, and agile project management practices.
* 10+ years of experience in High-Performance Computing System Engineering or Software with 5+ years in AI system optimization.
* Master's or PhD in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering.

##

## Job Area:

General Summary:
Qualcomm is seeking a visionary and execution-focused Senior Director of Engineering to lead AI for Snapdragon Compute platforms. This leader will define and drive Qualcomm's Compute AI software strategy across Snapdragon-powered Windows, Android, Linux PCs, enabling next-generation AI experiences and establishing Snapdragon as the premier platform for on-device AI computing.
The successful candidate will lead a global organization responsible for AI systems, model enablement, NPU, GPU, CPU software integration, AI performance optimization, developer enablement, AI benchmarking, ecosystem partnerships, and joint engineering engagements with Microsoft, Google, OEMs, ISVs, and strategic technology partners.
This role requires a unique combination of AI technical depth, platform systems expertise, and ecosystem influence to deliver industry-leading AI experiences spanning AI PCs, generative AI, multimodal AI, agentic AI, AI developer platforms, and future Snapdragon compute architectures. The role operates at the intersection of architecture, hardware, systems, software, AI algorithms, developer tools, and ecosystem enablement.
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
AI Strategy and Technical Leadership
* Define and execute Qualcomm's AI software strategy for Windows on Snapdragon platforms.
* Drive creation of differentiated AI experiences leveraging Snapdragon CPUs, NPUs, GPUs, and heterogeneous compute architectures.
* Influence future AI platform architecture requirements, software roadmaps, and ecosystem strategy.
* Establish long-term technology direction for on-device AI, generative AI, large language models, multimodal AI, computer vision, and agentic AI workloads.
* Partner with Compute, AI Software, System, Product Management, Customer Engineering, and Architecture teams to align investment priorities and execution plans.
Microsoft and Ecosystem Leadership
* Serve as engineering leader for strategic AI engagements with Microsoft.
* Drive co-engineering activities across Windows AI, WinML, Windows AI Foundry, ONNX Runtime, Copilot+, and next-generation Windows AI capabilities.
* Partner with Microsoft engineering organizations to define platform requirements, feature roadmaps, validation strategies, and performance targets.
* Lead engagements with OEMs, commercial customers, independent software vendors, and open-source communities to expand the AI ecosystem on Snapdragon PCs.
* Represent Qualcomm in executive-level technical discussions with strategic partners.
AI Platform and Systems Engineering
* Lead teams responsible for end-to-end AI software enablement across Snapdragon compute products.
* Drive optimization of AI workloads across NPU, GPU, CPU, and hybrid execution environments.
* Oversee AI runtime integration, model deployment frameworks, developer tooling, and software release readiness.
* Ensure successful enablement of emerging AI technologies and platform capabilities across current and future Snapdragon compute generations.
* Guide platform-level analysis involving performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, concurrency, scalability, and user experience.
AI Model Enablement and Optimization
* Drive onboarding, optimization, quantization, validation, and deployment of AI models on Snapdragon Compute platforms.
* Lead development of model acceleration strategies for generative AI, vision models, language models, multimodal models, and emerging workloads.
* Ensure world-class AI performance and efficiency through software and system optimization initiatives.
* Partner with AI framework teams to address operator gaps, conversion challenges, runtime enhancements, and model portability requirements.
AI Benchmarking and Competitive Leadership
* Define benchmarking strategy and performance targets for AI workloads.
* Drive leadership results across industry benchmarks and customer-facing workloads.
* Establish performance measurement methodologies and competitive analysis processes.
* Lead optimization efforts required to achieve benchmark leadership across Snapdragon PC platforms.
Engineering Organization Leadership
* Build, scale, and develop a high-performing global AI engineering organization.
* Recruit and retain world-class talent across AI systems, machine learning, software engineering, performance engineering, and developer technologies.
* Establish organizational structure, priorities, metrics, and execution frameworks.
* Mentor directors, senior managers, architects, and technical leaders.
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, technical excellence, and rapid execution.
Program Execution and Product Delivery
* Own execution of AI software deliverables across multiple Snapdragon Compute programs.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies spanning silicon, firmware, drivers, AI runtimes, operating systems, developer tools, applications, and ecosystem partners.
* Ensure timely delivery of AI features aligned with product milestones and customer commitments.
* Drive issue resolution, risk management, quality initiatives, and operational excellence.
Level of Responsibility
• Working independently with no supervision.
• Providing supervision to other supervisors/managers who may be direct reports.
• Making decisions that are significant in impact, influencing overall program or project success, finances, and/or the ability to meet objectives; errors are not readily apparent due to the complexity of work process/product or time between decisions and results; errors typically result in significant expenditure of time, resources, and funds to correct.
• Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple individuals/audiences with differing knowledge levels. Role may require strong negotiation and influence, communication to large groups or high-level constituents.
• Overall responsibility to ensure budgets, schedules, and performance standards for functional areas and organization are realistically set and attained.
• Having influence over the formulation and achievement of long-term business plans and objectives.
• Completing tasks that require multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; tasks require simultaneously executing multiple cognitive abilities and maintaining information in short- or long-term memory.
• Making overall determination with what needs to be done to drive implementation of innovative ideas/processes, etc.
• Working on abstract problems in variable situations that typically require complex analysis, interpretation, or evaluation of intangible factors; directing the resolution of complex problems that have impact beyond own area; participating in corporate development of methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people.
• Developing and redesigning organizational strategies and providing overall direction for various functional areas and/or entire organization. Has influence over the formulation and achievement of long-term business plans and objectives.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 10+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 9+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 8+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience.
Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
• 5+ years of experience with Machine Learning frameworks (e.g., Tensor Flow, Caffe, Caffe 2, Pytorch, Keras).
• 5+ years of experience with low level interactions between operating systems (e.g., Linux, Android, QNX) and Hardware.
• 5+ years of experience in embedded system development and optimization with application to a specific problem domain in ML (e.g., NLP, multi-media).
• 10+ years of experience with one or more programming language suitable for machine learning (e.g., Python, R, C, C++).
• 8+ years of experience using statistics and probability (e.g., conditional probability, Bayes rule).
• 8+ years in a technical leadership role with or without direct reports (only applies to positions with direct reports).
• 8+ years experience working in a large matrixed organization.
• 8+ years of work experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership (e.g., Vice President and above).

* Lead and coordinate all technical aspects of business acquisition, delivery execution, and post-SOP maintenance

Technical Leadership:
* Act as the chief technical counterpart to the OEM’s engineering leadership for ADAS related programs.
* Serve as the main technical point of contact covering SoC, platform software, tools, and system integration topics.
* Lead and manage automotive software engineering projects from conception to completion.
* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with the customer’s engineering executives, architects, and program leads.
* Anticipate customer needs and translate them into Qualcomm platform requirements, features, and solutions.

* Drive resolution of critical technical issues, ensuring timely escalation and clear communication to both customer and Qualcomm management.
* Support design reviews, technical workshops, joint debugging sessions, and on-site integration activities as needed.
* Identify, analyze, and mitigate project risks and issues.
* Prepare, schedule, coordinate, and monitor the assigned engineering projects.

* Represent the customer’s priorities, constraints, and pain points in internal reviews, roadmap discussions, and management meetings.
* Provide structured feedback to product management and engineering on gaps, competitive pressure, and future requirements.

Technical Thought Leadership & Mentoring

OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

##
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
## Job Area:
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering
General Summary:
We’re seeking an experienced AI Platforms Leader to own the strategy, architecture, and operation of our end‑to‑end AI Platform—spanning on‑prem GPU clusters and cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure). You’ll lead a high-caliber engineering team to deliver reliable, secure, and cost‑efficient infrastructure for training, fine‑tuning, inference, retrieval, and agentic orchestration (including A2A patterns and MCP servers). If you love turning complex AI/ML requirements into robust, self‑service platform capabilities for builders across the company, this is your role.
This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).
Key Responsibilities
* Own the AI Platform strategy & roadmap
* Define the multi‑year vision for a multi‑tenant, hybrid (on‑prem + cloud) AI platform, aligned to business needs, developer productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Establish clear platform SLAs/SLOs, reliability goals, and security/compliance guardrails.
* Run GPU-based compute at scale
* Operate and optimize on‑prem GPU clusters (e.g., Kubernetes + GPU operator and/or Slurm), including capacity planning, scheduling, partitioning, NCCL, and high‑throughput storage/networking.
* Drive GPU utilization efficiency, right‑sizing, and cost transparency across training and inference workloads.
* Deliver MLOps & LLMOps as a product
* Provide golden paths for data prep, training/fine‑tuning, model registry, lineage, governance, evaluation, red‑teaming, and safe deployment (batch, online, streaming).
* Implement CI/CD for models, prompts, and agents; automate evaluations and rollout/rollback with canaries, A/B, and shadow deployments.
* Agentic AI, A2A, and MCP ecosystem
* Lead the design and operation of agentic orchestration (A2A patterns), tool integration, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to securely expose enterprise tools and data.
* Standardize agent capability schemas, guardrails, observability, and policy enforcement.
* Cloud AI/ML platforms
* Leverage AWS/Azure AI services for training and inference (e.g., Bedrock/SageMaker/EKS; Azure AI Studio/Azure ML/AKS/Azure OpenAI) with robust networking, identity, secrets, and cost controls.
* Establish multi‑cloud patterns for portability, resilience, and vendor risk management.
* Platform engineering & DevOps excellence
* Own core platform services: identity/RBAC, secrets, service meshes, observability (logs/metrics/traces), data access controls, vector stores, feature stores, and model gateways (e.g., KServe/Triton/vLLM).
* Use GitOps/IaC (Terraform/Bicep/Helm) and secure software supply chain practices (SBOMs, image signing, policy as code).
* Operational leadership
* Lead a ~10‑engineer global team (platform, SRE, MLOps/LLMOps) with global collaboration, 24×7 readiness, and a healthy on‑call rotation.
* Drive incident response, post‑mortems, and continuous improvement. Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance for model/data governance.
* Stakeholder & vendor management
* Partner with product, data, and application teams to enable high‑impact AI use cases.
* Manage strategic vendors (e.g., cloud, GPU, enterprise AI tooling) and negotiate licenses/SOWs aligned to roadmap and budget.
Required Qualifications
* 15+ years overall engineering/technology experience, including ~10 years building and operating large‑scale platforms (AI/ML, data, or high‑performance computing).
* Leadership: Proven experience leading a team of ~10 engineers for 5+ years, across platform/SRE/MLOps/LLMOps, with coaching, hiring, performance management, and clear execution rhythms.
* GPU cluster expertise: Hands‑on operations for on‑prem GPU clusters (Kubernetes + GPU operator and/or Slurm), scheduling, capacity planning, performance tuning, and reliability.
* MLOps & LLMOps: Strong experience with model lifecycle (data → training → registry → deployment), model/agent evaluation, safety/guardrails, and observability.
* Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure): Deep experience with AI/ML services and managed Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), networking, security, identity, and cost management.
* DevOps/Platform Engineering: CI/CD, GitOps, IaC (Terraform/Bicep/Helm), containerization (Docker), Kubernetes, and secure SDLC practices.
* Agentic AI & MCP: Solid understanding of agent orchestration, A2A patterns, tool abstractions, and operating MCP servers in production.
* Operational excellence: Demonstrated success running AI or computing clusters with SLOs, on‑call, incident management, and post‑mortems.
* Global collaboration: Experience leading a distributed engineering team across time zones.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
Preferred Qualifications
* Master’s or PhD in CS/EE/Math or related field.
* Experience with:
* Training & Inference stacks: PyTorch, CUDA/cuDNN, Triton Inference Server, vLLM, KServe, Ray, Slurm.
* Data & storage: High‑throughput storage (e.g., Lustre, BeeGFS, Ceph), vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone, Azure AI Search), feature stores (e.g., Feast).
* MLOps toolchain: MLflow/Vertex/Azure ML/SageMaker registries, Airflow/Argo, Weights & Biases, LangSmith, Prompt/version management.
* Security & governance: OIDC/RBAC, policy as code (OPA), secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager/Azure Key Vault), model governance/risk controls, privacy/PII safeguards.
* Agentic frameworks: Semantic Kernel, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen (or equivalents) and experience integrating enterprise tools via MCP.
* Proven track record shipping platform capabilities that enable multiple product teams (self‑service, docs, SDKs, templates, golden paths).
* Strong communication with executives and technical leaders; clear metrics, dashboards, and business value storytelling.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
• 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

General Summary:
Qualcomm is seeking an experienced Engineer to lead software development and execution for next-generation mobile Premium Tier Handset Products. This leader will drive cross-functional engineering strategy, platform delivery, software architecture, productization, and customer enablement across flagship mobile chipset programs.
The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise with strong organizational leadership to drive complex platform execution across software, systems, silicon, product management, and customer engineering teams. This role requires influencing senior executives, leading large cross-functional organizations, and ensuring successful delivery of premium mobile Handset Products to global OEM customers.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Leadership & Execution
* Own end-to-end Mobile Handset Products software execution for multiple premium-tier chipset programs.
* Drive software readiness across major milestones including architecture definition, bring-up, feature development, integration, validation, commercialization, and customer launch.
* Establish execution strategies, operating mechanisms, and governance models to ensure predictable delivery of large-scale programs.
* Manage execution risk, dependency resolution, and cross-functional alignment across engineering organizations.
Technical Strategy & Architecture
* Provide technical leadership for platform software architecture spanning HLOS, firmware, middleware, virtualization, AI, and system software technologies.
* Drive long-term platform strategy, software reuse, scalability, and roadmap alignment.
* Partner with silicon, architecture, and product teams to influence future platform capabilities.
* Lead technology investments that improve platform quality, performance, security, power efficiency, and customer adoption.
Customer & Executive Engagement
* Represent software engineering in executive reviews with Qualcomm leadership.
* Engage directly with strategic OEM and ecosystem partners to align roadmaps and resolve critical issues.
* Lead communications during major escalations, launch readiness reviews, and customer engagements.
* Partner with product management, sales, and customer engineering organizations to drive successful product adoption.
Process & Productivity Transformation
* Drive initiatives that improve engineering productivity, platform stability, development velocity, and software quality.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts across integration, testing, release management, and upgrade workflows.
* Champion scalable platform solutions that reduce engineering effort and accelerate time-to-market.
Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
• 4+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.
Preferred Qualifications
* Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
* 15+ years of software engineering experience with increasing leadership responsibility.
* 8+ years leading managers and senior technical leaders.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale commercial products in mobile, embedded, or system software environments.
* Strong expertise in operating systems, system software, platform architecture, or mobile technologies.
* Experience leading multi-disciplinary organizations across software, systems, and hardware domains.
* Track record of driving execution across geographically distributed teams.
* Experience leading flagship mobile platform programs from concept through commercialization.
* Deep understanding of Android platform development and ecosystem requirements.
* Experience with AI/ML platforms, virtualization, security technologies, and next-generation computing architectures.
* Proven success managing executive stakeholder relationships and customer engagements.
* Strong ability to balance technology innovation with business and product objectives.
